sanskrit: ullāse prathame vakṣye nigamāgamalakṣaṇam tricatuḥpañcamolāse sṛṣṭyutpattiṃ vadāmyaham ācārañcāṣṭame vakṣye kumāryā lakṣaṇaṃ vidhim daśame śrīgurordhyānamekādaśe'pi lakṣaṇam vakṣye caturdaśollāse bali-lakṣaṇamuttamam vakṣye pañcadaśollāse śaivācāraṃ tathaiva ca tattvasyaivānukalpañca tilakañcaiva ṣoḍaśe śāktācārakramaṃ vakṣye vāmadakṣiṇabhedataḥ lakṣaṇaṃ sādhakānāñca divyacakrasya lakṣaṇam cakrasthānamāsanañca cakramadhye praveśanam jātyabhedaṃ cakramadhye tathā dravyanirūpaṇam dvāviṃśatikollāse pātrādhārau ca lakṣaṇau dravyābhedaṃ śaktiśuddhiṃ caturviṃśatike'pi ca ānandabhairavadhyānaṃ tathaivānandabhairavīm māṃsaṃ matsyañca mudrāñca lakṣaṇaṃ śodhanaṃ tathā vakṣye'haṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śakteraṣṭāviṃśatike'pi ca vidhānaṃ samvidā-pānamullāse triṃśadike'pi ca ekatriṃśadikolāse vakṣye nānāprakārakam vaṭukādivalistritriṃśadike parikīrtitaḥ pañcatriṃśadike vakṣye prāthanaṃ pātravandanam saptatriṃśadikollāse śrīgurordhyānalakṣaṇam ūnacatvāriṃśadīti pañcamasya vidhānakam ekacatvāriṃśadīti pañcamānāndalakṣaṇam ānandaṃ navapātrasya tricatvāriṃśadīti ca pañcacatvāriṃśadīti ānandastotramuttamam

saptacatvāriṃśadīti dakṣiṇācārabhāvakam puṣpapramāṇaṃ tatraiva pañcadhā saptadheti ca vakṣye pañcāśadullāse lakṣaṇaṃ kulayoṣitām dvāpañcāśadikollāse śaktijñānaṃ prakāśakam catuḥpañcāśadulāse pūrṇānandaviśeṣakam ṣaṭpañcāśadikolāse śaktyānandasya lakṣaṇam aṣṭapañcāśadullāse haṃsabījasya lakṣaṇam divyācārakramaṃ vakṣye ṣaṣṭamullāse suniścitam prakṛterlakṣaṇaṃ yad yat svarūpañca dviṣaṣṭike catuḥṣaṣṭau samāptaśca granthollāsa-yathoditaḥ sarvollāsaṃ mahollāsaṃ mahollāse vadāmyaham śrīsarvānandanāthoktaṃ śrīdevyāścaraṇāmbuje prakṛterlakṣaṇaṃ kiñcittava sthāne vadāmyaham triguṇānāṃ samānānāṃ prakṛtiḥ sūkṣmarūpiṇau nityānityaprabodhārthaṃ heturjñeyaḥ parasparam nityānityaṃ jagat sarvamātmarūpeṇa bhāvitam paramātmā ca vāhyātmā jīvātmeti prakīrtitam tejodhyānaṃ mahadrūpaṃ tejīyaḥ sūkṣmarūpakam tejodhyānaṃ vinā kaścid (?) dhyānamātraṃ nacecchive sthūlasyāpi ca sūkṣmasya tejoheturdhruvantathā mano'tītaṃ sūkṣmamekamekamātraṃ nirañjanam sākṣivadbhāti tadbrahma prakṛtirvikṛtiḥ śive mataḥ śrīvāsudevasya tasmānnigama ucyate mataḥ śrīvāsudevasya tasmādāgama ucyate nandīśvarāya tadvākyaṃ nigamāgamasammatam

evaṃ parasparaṃ vyāpta āgamonigamaḥ kṣitau yāmalañca caturdhoktaṃ tasmācchāstraṃ prakāśitam yāmaloktaṃ sthūlarūpaṃ sarvaśāstrasya bodhanam yāmalañca caturdhoktaṃ tasmācchāstraṃ prakāśitam yāmalādveda-saṃjātaṃ vedājjātaṃ purāṇakam tāni gṛhṇāṇi yatnena cottamaṃ hi kramotkramāt dvāpare ca purāṇāni kalāvāgamasammatam nahi devāḥ prasīdanti kalau cāndhavidhāntaḥ purāṇānyaṅgaśāstrāṇi cāṅgaṃ pratyaṅgakaṃ smṛtiḥ śāstreṇa jñāyate rūpaṃ devatāyāḥ prabhedakam jīvātmā yāmalaṃ proktaṃ vāhyātmā vedarūpakam anyāni yāni śāstrāṇi tanūruhāṇi pārvati śakti-yāmalasambhūtamatharvaṃ paramaṃ mahat dvāpareca yajurvedamartharvasya mataṃ kalau || 0 prathamollāsaḥ adhunā śrotumicchāmi tantranāmānukīrtanam tava snehena vaddho'smi tantrākhyāṃ kathayāmyaham mama prāṇādhikaṃ tantraṃ lokānāṃ muktidāyakam gadituṃ naiva śaknomi brahmāṇḍānte'pi pārvati śivasāraṃ vīratantraṃ liṅgārcana-latārcane viśvasāraṃ bhairavākhyaṃ bhairavītantrameva ca guptasādhanatantrañca mātṛkātantrameva ca kumāryākhyāmahattantraṃ kulārṇavamataḥparam vārāhī yoginītantraṃ yoginīhṛdayaṃ śive yoginīvijayaṃ bhadre mālinītantrameva ca

bhūtatantraṃ tathoḍḍīśaṃ kāmadhenu tathottamam kulacūḍāmaṇitantraṃ bhāvacūḍāmaṇi priye kālīvilāsakaṃ tantraṃ haṃsatantraṃ maheśvari phetkāriṇīñca nityākhyaṃ tantramuttarasaṃjñakam jñānadvīpaṃ gautamīyaṃ tantraṃ niruttaraṃ śive vṛhat śrīkramatantrañca svatantraṃ tantrakaṃ śive catuḥṣaṣṭyāni (?) tantrāṇi mayaivoktāni saṃprati asaṃkhyāni ca tantrāṇi bhāvāni vividhāni ca pradhānametadvijñeyaṃ caturyugamataṃ dhruvam || 0 dvitīyollāsaḥ sṛṣṭipralayamāhātmyaṃ mama sthāne prakāśaya pralayañca vinā devi kā sṛṣṭiścopajāyate tathā sṛṣṭi-layaṃ devi nityānityaṃ hi kalpanam sṛṣṭi-pralaya-māhātmyaṃ gadituṃ naiva śakyate tava snehena vaddho'haṃ kiñcinmātraṃ prakāśitam puruṣarūpadhṛka] kecidvadanti prakṛtiṃ kecicca puruṣaṃ śive tadbrahmāvācyaṃ vijñeyaṃ vācātītaṃ sunirmalam jñānārthaṃ sādhakasyāpi vadāmyekatvamāśritam puruṣājjāyate sarvaṃ prakṛtyā api lālasāt puruṣādapi sraṣṭāhaṃ (?) viparītā vabhūva sā mahākālīpralīno'tra mahākālaḥ prakīrtitaḥ vidyāvidyobhayorekā bhāvātītā maheśvarī ubhayorekabhāvatvaṃ prakṛti-puruṣātmakam patiṃ dehi jaganmātaḥ kāmabhāvena kāṅghitā

samāśritā] rājarājeśvarī vidyā sarvadevaprapūjitā patiṃ dehi mahākālī-kāraṇānandasaṃyutam dakṣabhāgaṃ samāśritya sarvadā parisaṃsthitaḥ vāme ca ṣoḍaśī jñeyā dakṣiṇe puruṣo'vyayaḥ sādhakasya hitārthāya svānandārthe maheśvari bhuvaneśī bhairavī ca chinnamastā maheśvari ityaṣṭaśaktisaṃyuktaścāṣṭabhāgaḥ sadāśivaḥ yasya vijñānamātraṃ hi jīvanmuktasya kāraṇam madirāghūrṇanayanā madanākāṅkṣitā sadā tasyā yoniṃ samāsādya śṛṅgārasṛṣṭimān sadā [g: mudā ] sundarī sṛṣṭirūpā ca sṛṣṭirūpamidaṃ priye kṣaṇakākārarūpā sā bhāvātītā samāśritā uvāca paramā śaktiḥ śṛṅgāraṃ kuru me priya tatkṣaṇāt sā mahāśaktiḥ kṛṣṇo'bhūt parameśvarī sṛṣṭirūpamidaṃ jñeyaṃ vaiṣṇavasya mataṃ dhruvam śiśubhāvasamāśritāḥ; kh: bhāvaśṛṅgārasamāśritāḥ] balidānānvitaṃ devi puraścaraṇasaṃyutam paramāścarya-sat-śobhā trikuṭā triguṇānvitā tribhuṣā ca trirūpā ca tripurāyai namonamaḥ svecchayā sā mahāvidyā tejīyastvā vivarddhinī yadā dakṣasamāsādyastadā sā dakṣiṇā parā mahākālīmahākālī yonimadhye layaḥ priye tasyāstrirekhā vijñeyā tripurātripurātmikā śūnyaṃ candraṃ vārṇañca tripuraṃ parikalpitam

śaktimātrasthitā nityā trikuṭeti mahākalā tadā sā tāriṇī vidyā mahāghorapareśvarī dvitīyā sā mahāvidyā pūrṇabhāvena kāminī iti śrutvā mahādevaḥ saṃkṣobhyañca parityajet ekātmābhāṅmahādevo dvitvātmā tāriṇī tadā stotraṃ kuryānmahādevyāstāriṇyāstrāṇadāyakam caturbhujā nīlavarṇā trinetrā śavavāhinī caturbhujā kṛṣṇavarṇā trinetrā śavavāhanā dṛṣṭvaitat kālikāṃ vidyāṃ śrīvidyā tripurātmikā ādāntamadhyarahitā nityā sarvaprapūjitā tritārūpā sundarī syāt [g: syuḥ] tretāyāṃ phaladāyinī [gh: kalautu tripurāpūjyā kālīti tripurāparā ] ubhayormilitā tārā tāreti cobhayātmikā ekā vidyā trināmākhyā tamaḥ sattvaṃ rajastathā eka deveti caikātmā kālītāreti sundarī tridhaikātmā yadā jñātvā tadā mokṣaṃ layaṃ dhruvam tejīyaścaiva sārūpyaṃ sāyojyambā maheśvari catuyugamataḥparam; kh: caturvargamataḥ param] tṛtīyollāsaḥ gaṅgādi nāsti tīrthādi viprādirjātibhedakaḥ siddhāntaścāpi kaulaśca etadbhāvaṃ naced yadā kathaya prāṇanātheśa sandeho yena naśyati tyāgaṃ śṛṅgāramākarṣaṃ gamanaṃ stutigañjanam daśendriyamiti proktaṃ mana ekādaśaṃ priye mano'pi naiṣṭhikaṃ yatra tatrendriyalayaṃ dhruvam

jale naṣṭe punaśchāyā vṛkṣādiṣu pralīyate manasyutpadyate sarvaṃ bhāvamindiryasaṃyutam indriyasya gaterbhāvādācāro jāyate priye kriyāmātraṃ jagat sarvaṃ jagattasyāpi bījakam devavākyaṃ śāstramūlaṃ devaḥ sādhakamūlakaḥ phalamūlaṃ sukhaṃ deva sukhamānandamūlakam tattvamūlaṃ jñeyamātraṃ tattvaṃ hi brahmamūlakam aikyaṃ hi parameśāna bhāvātītaṃ suniścitam aṅkuraḥ syād yatra bīje tasmāvṛkṣaḥ praphullakaḥ dvayoryogaṃ vinā deva kiñcinmātraṃ na jāyate dvitīyādisthite deva caikatvaṃ naiva jāyate saṃkhyeyasya mahādeva saṃkhyayasya vivakṣitam ahaṃ tvaṃ ko mahādeva kathaṃ kasmādvadasva me bhāvābhāvavinirmuktamabhāvaṃ bhāvameva ca yathā darpaṇabimbeṣu pratibimbañca darśanam dvitvamekatvasaṃyuktamekatvaṃ dvitvasaṃyutam dvitvabhāvaṃ vinaikatvaṃ kathamutpadyate śive parasparaṃ vinā vākyaṃ gadituṃ naiva śakyate parasparaṃ vinā kiñcid jñānamātraṃ nacet kvacit phalaṃ vinā kriyā na syāt phalaṃ na syāt kriyāṃ vinā jñānaṃ bhāvaṃ maheśāni jñeyaṃ bhāvavivarjitam ekabhāvaṃ dvibhāvāktaṃ dvibhāvamekabhāvakam tvaṃ jñānañca vinā kvāpi ahaṃ jñānaṃ na jāyate tathāhaṃ tvaṃ sarvarūpaḥ sarvadravyeṣu saṃsthitaḥ yathaitattena khaṇḍātmā varjite vyāpitaṃ jagat

tathāhaṃ tvaṃ dehalakṣo dehaṃ hi tanmayaṃ dhruvam dehe naṣṭe tathāhaṃ tvaṃ paramātmani līyate iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse caturthollasaḥ māyayāchāditātmānaṃ kṣaṇakākārarūpiṇī bhūtvā yadonmukhī prathame jāyate puttro brahmasaṃjño hi pārvati etacchrutvā tato brahmā uvāca sādaraṃ priye tacchrutvā jagatāṃ mātā svadehānmohinīṃ dadau asyāḥ saṅgaṃ samāsādya vedavistāraṇaṃ kuru puttro viṣṇuḥ sattvaguṇāśayaḥ tava darśanamātreṇa niṣkāmī jāyate pumān nirvāṇatantrīyapāṭhaḥ)|] dadau tasmai ca kālikā tāmāśritya mahāviṣṇuḥ pālayatyakhilaṃ jagat taṃ dṛṣṭvā sā mahākālī tuṣṭiyuktā bhavettadā atastvaṃ paramānanda vivāhaṃ kuru me śiva satyametajjaganmātarmāṃ vinā puruṣo na ca kuru dehāntaraṃ mātaḥ karuṇā yadi vartate ādibhūtā yathā kālī tathā bhuvanasundarī śambhunāṣṭavidhobhavet] mayyanugrahaḥ aviśeṣaṃ tathā jñeyaṃ jīvātma-paramātmanoḥ nānārupavatī gauḥ syāttathā [k: dugdhaṃ] nānātmako layaḥ sthūlasūkṣmobhayornāśe tadeva paramātmakam deheṣu dehiśabdakam] rūpaṃ] nāśakartṛkam

māyayācchāditātmānaṃ tanmadhye samabhāvataḥ mahābrahmā sa evātmā nāmamātravibhedakaḥ nānābhāvamano yasya tasya muktirna vidyate tatra brahmā tatra viṣṇustatra rudraḥ pravinyaset kecidvadanti rudraḥ sa eko devo nirañjanaḥ tatraiva vartate nityaścaṇakākārarūpakaḥ nityānandakarā devi kālikā dakṣiṇe sthitā jāyate ca kṣitau vṛkṣo yathā pṛthvyāṃ pralīyate jalade taḍitutpattiryathā meghe pralīyate tathā pralayakāletu punastasyāṃ pralīyate (?) ekāṃśena bhavedbrahmā ekāṃśena janārdanaḥ aparā sā mahākālī nadyādīnāṃ samudravat goṣpade kiṃ vijānīyāt samudrasya jalaṃ śive sṛṣṭikartryā yadā kālyā pālyante ca surādayaḥ ato nirvāṇadā kālī puruṣasya ca śarmadāa [gh: saṣvadā] yathā sūryo jagadbhāti jñeyañca kṣaṇakaṃ tathā punaḥ pralīna-kāle'pi dvidhaikaṃ puṃsagopitam nityānityaṃ yadaikātmā tadaikaṃ brahmavigraham ṣaṣṭhollāsaḥ sūcitaṃ parameśāni kathayasvānukampayā tathāpi śaktitantreṣu viśeṣaṃ sarvasādhanam ācāreṇa vinā bhāvaṃ kadācinnaiva jāyate bhāvavān phalabhāk kimbā kena vācāravān bhavet kiñcid bhāvaṃ pravaktavyaṃ diṅmātradarśanaṃ yathā tathā bhāvaṃ mahādeva manasā paribhāvyate

manasīti sthito bhāvaḥ punarmanasi līyate tathā bhāvaṃ maheśāna manasyeva na saṃśayaḥ kriyāktvadbhavedbhāvaḥ svarṇasya kuṇḍalādivat kena rūpeṇa loko'pi phalabhāg jāyate naraḥ śabdamūlo bhavedbhāvo bhāvaṃ hi sarvamūlakam pumān strīveśadhārī ca yathāṅgaṃ bhaṅgavat śive napuṃsakasya kāntā kiṃ patyānandavivarddhinī kriyā-śakto bhāvayukto phalabhāk parameśvari bhāvamūlā kriyā proktā na bhāvena kriyā katham parasparaṃ vinā na syāt jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ yathāpriye na bhavena mahādevi kriyāpi na phalapradā kiṃ pīṭhapūjanenaiva kiṃ kanyābhojanādibhiḥ yadi bhāvaviśuddhiḥ syānnasyāt phalaparāyaṇaḥ bhāvena gotravṛddhiḥ syādbhāvena kulaśodhanam kiṃ tathā pūjanenaiva yadi bhāvo na jāyate phalābhāvācca deveśi bhāvābhāvaḥ prajāyate jaḍo'pi śuddhatāṃ yāti bhāvanārasatatparaḥ bandhaṃ muktiṃ tathābhāvaṃ bhāvena labhate'pi ca bhāvena labhate sarvaṃ pāpaṃ puṇyañca niścitam jīvātmānaṃ parātmānaṃ bhāvena labhate'pi ca bhuktambā copavāsambā bhāvena labhate dhruvam bhāvena labhate'pyetān bhāve'pyetān vinaśyati bhāvena labhate'pyetān bhāve'pyetān vinaśyati teṣāṃ madhye śreṣṭhabhāvaṃ mamasthāne prakāśaya prakāśamātraṃ trividhaṃ bhāvācāraṃ maheśvari

mokṣaṃ bhāvantyuttamāśca bhāvātītāstaduttamāḥ uttamā mokṣadācārāḥ svecchācārāstaduttamāḥ mokṣaṃ paśyantyuttamāśca nāpaśyantyuttamottamāḥ uttamā mokṣabhītāśca bhīto nāstyuttamottamāḥ jñānī janmottamaḥ mokto janma nāstyuttamottamaḥ uttamaścaikajanmāpi janma nāstyuttamottamaḥ uttamaṃ yoniyantraśca sarvayantottamottamam saptamollāsaḥ ācārastrividho devi krameṇodāhṛto mayā ekabhāvaḥ paraṃ brahma sarvavighnapraṇāśakam ekabhāvaḥ kathaṃ deva mama sthāne prakāśaya kumārī tatra vikhyātā yantra-tantraphalapradā tatra bhāvaḥ prakāśo yaḥ sa bhāvaḥ paramo mataḥ tāvad yuvatī vikhyātā tasyāṃ pūjā mahāphalā tadante ṣoḍaśābde ca kalā sādhyakalā śive kalā kā parameśāna mama sthāne prakāśaya kāmavāyumujjhitāyāḥ pūjane nāsti yogyatā kumārīṃ pūjayeddevi kāmabhāvena [gh: vīrabhāvena] pūjayet aṣṭamollāsaḥ siddhāntaṃ vā maheśāni kaulabhāvaṃ samāśritam divyaḥ siddhantaḥ kaulaśca ṣaṭprakāraḥ kathaṃ vada caturdhā divyaḥ kaulaśca śakteśca puruṣasya ca ṣaḍācāraṃ caturbhāvaṃ kauljñānañca kiṃ vada caturdhābhāvasaṃyutāt vīraśca dvividho devi vibhāvaśca sabhāvakaḥ

sarve kaulapathālambā nadyādīnāṃ samudravat kaulārthaṃ hi kriyāmātraṃ kauleṣu muktibhāg bhavet vaiṣṇavāduttamaḥ śaivaḥ śaivācca śākta uttamaḥ dakṣiṇāduttamo vāmo vāmāt siddhanta uttamaḥ kaulācāraṃ bhāvamātraṃ kaulaṃ hi bhāvavarjitam paradravye na lobhaḥ syānna bhogaṃ manasā smaret bilvamūle vivikte ca puṇyakṣetre suśobhane na śūdradarśanaṃ kuryāt kauṭilyaṃ dūratastyajet rātrau yantrañca mālāñca spṛśennaiva kadācana yathātmakalpanaṃ jīvaṃ tattvajñānasya kāraṇam jñānalubdhastathā śiṣyo gurorvurvantaraṃ vrajet śikṣāguruṃ na kurvīta paśubhāvayuto yadi tathā guruṃ paśurdevi gurorandhraṃ na kalpayet [gh: kārayet] navamollāsaḥ nānācārayuto loko vada kena bhaviṣyati vīraṃ divyañca kaulañca siddhāntaṃ kena tadvada tadācārayuto mantrī bhaviṣyati yuge yuge vīramukhānmantralabdho vīra eva na saṃśayaḥ śubham tasmāt sarvaprayatnena paśordīkṣāṃ na kalpayet ata eva paśordīkṣāṃ vīrabhāvī na cācaret śaiśavaḥ] patiḥ lakṣaṇam yadi muktirna jāyeta tadā vākyaṃ vṛthā mama tasmāt sarvaprayatnena paśordīkṣāṃ vivarjayet

vīrabhāvānvito mantrī paśordīkṣāṃ vivarjayet kulanāthaṃ samāśritya punardīkṣāṃ samācaret vibhāve dīkṣite mantre kevalo bhayamātrakaḥ tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kulīnaṃ gurumāśrayet tridhaikaṃ cintayed yastu bhāvātītaṃ guruṃ priye kadācit hṛdayāmbhoje [g: -mbuje] kadācid dṛṣṭigocare sthūladhyānaṃ bāhyadeśe trividha dhyānajaṃ phalam dvandvātītaṃ gaganasadṛśaṃ tattvamasyādilakṣyam bhāvātītaṃ triguṇarahitaṃ sadguruṃ taṃ namāmi nityabodhaṃ cidānandaṃ guruṃ brahma namāmyaham varapradānam pūrṇakṛpānidhānam namāmi tridhā dhyāne dhyānaniṣṭhaḥ sa guruḥ sthūlarūpakaḥ adhunā śrotumicchāmi sadgurorlakṣaṇaṃ priya sahasrāre hṛdmbhoje bāhye'pi parameśvari sacchandaṃ ca vinā bhadre guruśabdaṃ nacet kvacit sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇaḥ sarvāvayava-śobhitaḥ loke sammohanakaro devatābhāvadarśakaḥ śreṣṭhātiśreṣṭhaṃ sacchabdaṃ sauvarṇa kuṇḍalaṃ yathā guravaśca tridhā proktāstathaiva mantradevatāḥ kulatattva-vihitajño gurureko hi durlabhaḥ bhāvayuktaṃ varārohe bhāgyena labhate'pi ca kuladīkṣāṃ tadā kuryād dṛṣṭvā śrutvā na kārayet nāśayanti kulaṃ tasya saṃkruddhā yoginīgaṇāḥ

vṛthācāro bhavettasya na vandhaṃ jalasecanam kāntaṃ vinā puttravatī tadā kāntā bhaviṣyati tanmukhāt śravaṇāt kārye phalabhāg jāyate naraḥ saṃpūjā paramāṃ devīṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim teṣāṃ madhye guṇaikākto durlabho gururīśvari darśanāt mucyate pāpāt kriyāpi suphalā bhavet kathayasva mama sthāne yadi te mayyanugrahaḥ śuddhācāraḥ supratiṣṭhaḥ śucirdakṣaḥ subuddhimān nigrahānugrahe śakto gururityavadhīyate sa śānto hi hṛṣṭamanāḥ sarvadā deva-tatparaḥ dayāyukto rāgamukto dānteti gurulakṣaṇam kulāgāre kriyāyuktaḥ [gh: -śakto] kulīno gururīśvari abhaktabhaktijanako vinīto gurulakṣaṇam tadācārarato devi guruḥ syāt śuddhaveśavān stutinindāvinirmuktaḥ śuddhācāro guruḥ svayam sarvānandapradāyakaḥ] śucirdakṣo gururdevi sarvakāryeṣu dakṣakaḥ subuddhimān gururdevi so'haṃ jñānaṃ vinaśyati tasminnānandamāśritya āśramī gururīśvari sa guruḥ parameśāni dhyānaniṣṭho bhaved dhruvam sa guruḥ parameśāni mantratantraviśāradaḥ nigrahānugrahe śakto gururityavadhīyate ekādaśollāsaḥ sa eva vaiṣṇavācāraḥ kāmasaṅkalpavarjitaḥ śaktitantre varārohe paśubhāvo bhayaṅkaraḥ

yadi syāt pūjayeddevīṃ vṛthā tasya pariśramaḥ vīrabhāve'pi tanmantraṃ caturvargaphalapradam rauravaṃ narakaṃ yāti yāvadāhūtasaṃplavam pūjayet kālikāṃ devīmanyathā niṣphalā bhavet abhuktaḥ pūjanenaiva viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate krimiḥ anyārcane mahādevi ceti bhāvena pūjayet sveṣṭadevaṃ stuvan bhāvyamanyadevaṃ na pūjayet varjayet parameśāni guroranyaṃ na bhāvayet darpaṇeṣu yathā bimbaṃ tathānyadevarūpakam ekasūryaṃ vinā sūryo nāstīha jagati yathā bahubhāve tathā devaṃ bahurūpeṣu dṛśyate dharmaṃ tyaktvā mahādevi kimālambitamāsthitaḥ dharmātmano devatātma-svātmanoḥ paricintanam yathā stanaṃ bālakasya pānaṃ dharmātmavarddhanam dvādaśollāsaḥ kimiṣṭaṃ kāpi bhaktiḥ syāt mama sthāne prakāśaya kriyāpi tasya vākye syāt kriyeti bhaktikalpanā bhaktirūpā sveṣṭavidyā vinā bhaktiṃ na labhyate sā bhaktistrividhā deva cottamā madhyamādhamā tāmasī bhaktiradhamā tridhā bhaktirmaheśvara bhedamidaṃ śiva] bhāvabhedena kathaya sādhakasyāpi lakṣaṇam tāmasaśca maheśāni teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam sa sāttviko maheśāni sarvadā devatatparaḥ sa rājaso maheśāni rāgātmā rāgakāṅkṣaṇaḥ

aśraddhayā yajeddevaṃ tāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ kriyāyāṃ dakṣiṇāhīnaḥ so'pi tāmasalakṣaṇaḥ kathaya prāṇanātheśa yadi te mayyanugrahaḥ sā pūjā trividhā proktā cottamā madhyamādhamā tāmasī trividhā pūjā tāsāṃ bhedaṃ vadāmyaham sā pūjā sāttvikī jñeyā pūjāmadhyeṣu gopitā sā pūja sāttvikī jñeyā cādhamā prāṇavallabhe kāmasaṅkalparahitā pūjā rājasikottamā devyāḥ sā rājasī pūjā madhyamā prāṇavallabhe kāmasaṅkalpasaṃyuktā pūjā rājasikādhamā śraddhānvitā kāmayuktā sā pūjā tāmasottamā sā pūjā tāmasī jñeyā madhyamā prāṇavallabhe sā pūjā tāmasī jñeyā cādhamā prāṇavallabhe parasparaṃ vinā na syāt jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ yathā priye trayodaśollāsaḥ bhāvabhedena kathaya balidānasya lakṣaṇam balidānaṃ vinā devi pūjane nāsti yogyatā balidānaṃ bhavet sāraṃ pūjane jñānvān yadi balidānaṃ vidhānena kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtale yato brahmamayaṃ dehaṃ ghātayet kena karmaṇā sattvevārambhakaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ balidānaṃ layaṃ śive māṃsaraktādirahitaṃ balidānaṃ phalaṃ śubham prānihiṃsā nacet satye tretāyāṃ dvāpare śubham narānukalpaṃ mahiṣaṃ mahiṣasya ca chāgalam kīṭamātrakam

anukalpaṃ kalau bhadre dravyābhāve parityajet balidānaṃ vinā devi hiṃsā sarvatra garhitā vidhināpi dvijaṃ gāmbā hatvā pāpairna lipyate balimātraṃ dvidhā jñeyaṃ tayorbhedaṃ śṛṇuṣva me balihīnā ca yā pūjā sā pūjā na phalapradā māṃsaraktādisaṃyuktaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ viśeṣataḥ evaṃ datvā baliṃ pūrṇaṃ phalamāpnoti sādhakaḥ kāminīṃ śṛṅgabhaṅgena kāṇena bhrātaraṃ tathā hataṃ mitraṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhe bhraṣṭaśrīḥ pucchahīnataḥ tasyāpi ghātane bhadre svātmaputtraṃ vinaśyati śukralīne [gh: hīne]'pi vṛddhaṃ hi ghātanād gurughātanam balidānaṃ vṛthā tasya kevalaṃ prāṇi [gh: paśu-]ghātanam pūjāhīnasya bhraṣṭatvāt nāmamātrastu sādhakaḥ vidhānaṃ naiva kartavyaṃ balidānaṃ hi mātrakam caturdaśollāsaḥ tadā dhyānaṃ sadā kāryaṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ paramāṃ śivām śaivācāramidaṃ proktaṃ paśvācāreṇa pūjayet vīrācāreṇa saṃpūjyaṃ pañcatattvena śaṅkari pracakṣate yogāṅgāṣṭāni pārvati daśadhā lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ yogāṅgasya yamasya ca daśadhā niyamaṃ proktaṃ yogāṅgasya ca pārvati vīrāsanamiti proktaṃ kramādāsanapañcakam padmāsanamiti proktaṃ japapūjādiṣu priye ṛjukāyo viśenmantrī svastikaṃ tat pracakṣate

karau nirudhyā[gh: nidadhyāt]dākhyātaṃ vajrāsanamudīritam ṛjukāyo viśenmantrī vīrāsanamudīritam prāṇāyāmañcāsanañca sarvācārasya sammatam tadā kāryaṃ na kartavyaṃ kriyāmātre hi sundari nidrāṃ tyaktvā sveṣṭarūpaṃ dhārayet parameśvari prāṇāyāmaṃ hi kathanaṃ devatāyāḥ svarūpakam svarūpadarśanāt śīghraṃ svarūpañca svayaṃ bhavet gurudhyānāttathā nityaṃ dehī brahmamayo bhavet prāṇāyāmaḥ śaṅkaro'pi sṛṣṭisthitilayātmakaḥ recako'pi svayaṃ rudraḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ guṇatrayam prāṇāyāmaḥ sa vijñeyastarjanīmadhyame vinā recanaṃ dakṣanāḍyāpi tadarddhajapasaṃkhyayā iḍāyāṃ pūrayedvāyuṃ dhārayeddakṣanāsikām piṅgalāyāṃ recayecca dhāraṇād vāmanāsikām pratyahāradviṣṭkena jānīyāddharaṇaṃ śubham samādhimatha [gh: samādheratha] karmāṇi karoti na karoti vā khecaratvaṃ samādhitvaṃ kāle mṛtyurvinaśyati adhunā śrotumicchāmi samādhisthasya lakṣaṇam tadā dhyānaṃ sadā kāryaṃ śivaṃ śāntaṃ jaganmayam pañcadaśollāsaḥ paśvācāramidaṃ proktaṃ vibhāvasya mataṃ śive [gh: priye] guḍaṃ tasya madyatulyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ cūrṇasaṃyutam lavaṇaṃ saindhavaṃ vinā] dagdhañcet parameśāni paśormatsyaṃ hi kalpanam mudrānukalpaṃ parame vibhāvasya mataṃ paśoḥ

sahasrāre mahāpadme śivaśaktisamanvitam yatstuṣṭā bhagavatī svātmabimbaprakāśinī vedoktena yajeddevaṃ vibhāvasya mataṃ paśoḥ kadācinnaiva vaktavyaṃ pāṣaṇḍe nāstike nare vīrabhāvaṃ vinā devi devīpūjā vṛthā bhavet mānasaikavibhāvena pañcatattvena pūjayet sukhamokṣadam] pañcatattvasyānukalpairvāhye devīṃ prapūjayet pañcatattvamidaṃ proktaṃ śāktanāṃ sukhamokṣadam madyānukalpaṃ parame ! caturvargaphalapradam tadabhāve'pi go-kṣīraṃ dvijo dadyād yuge yuge ete cāṣṭau surāḥ proktāḥ sādhakānandadāyakāḥ lasūnañca maheśāni māṃsapratinidhiḥ smṛtaḥ mudrābhāve'pi kṣaṇakaṃ bharjitaṃ parameśvari kruddhā bhagavatī tasya niṣphalaṃ japapūjanam pūjayet sādhakaḥ śreṣṭho yonipūjāphalāptaye tasyābhāve kathaṃ deva cānukalpāparājitā maithunaṃ kena deveśa tattvaṃ kena vada prabho kṛṣṇo'bhūt parameśāni tadā jātāparājitā yonicihnaṃ sthitaṃ tatra devi kāmakalātmikam yonisvarūpaṃ tat puṣpaṃ devyāḥ prītikaraṃ param pūjayed vīrabhāvī ca yonipūjāphalaṃ labhet maithunaṃ jāyate tena śaktyābhāve'pi sundari tasmāduddhṛtya tattvañca tarpayet paradevatām mahāpīṭhamayaṃ puṣpaṃ sarvadevasya durlabham

rādhikābhūnmahādevaḥ śṛṅgārānandahetave ātmayonimimāṃ jñātvā svamūrddhni dhārayeddhariḥ tadabhāve cānukalpaiḥ sādhakābhīṣṭasiddhaye [gh: -dāyake] śukrabhāve cānukalpaṃ sugandhaṃ malayodbhavam dvayoryogānmaheśāni kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtale lalāṭe dhāraṇād bhadre śivatulyo na saṃśayaḥ puṣpeṇa tilakaṃ bhāle sadeva rūpavān bhavet anukalpaiśca tilakaiḥ sārūpyameti sundari madhyasthāne vasedviṣṇuḥ tatsthānaṃ naiva lepayet yadā sākārarūpo'sau dvibhujo muralīdharaḥ tadūrddhe bindurūpā ca mūlā tripurasundarī kuṇḍalī mūlabhāge'pi tilakaṃ triguṇātmakam jāhnavī yamunādevī vāgdevī sarvadā sthitā ūrddhapuṇḍraṃ gāṇapatyaḥ sādhakasyāpi lakṣaṇam evaṃ krameṇa deveśi sādhako'pi kriyāñcaret ṣoḍaśollāsaḥ adhunā śrotumicchāmi yantraprastāvamuttamam vīrasyāpi vibhāvasya sabhāvasya vada prabho kṛtrimaṃ svakṛtaṃ yantraṃ vibhāvasyānukalpanam ata eva maheśāni kuryāt yantrānukalpanam ghaṭadvayaṃ na kuryeyuḥ sādhakāḥ siddhihetave ekayantraṃ kalpanīyaṃ dvikalpe dvitvapūjanam prakuryāttu tantrayantraṃ na kārayet |"] dviguṇaṃ balidānaṃ syād dviguṇaṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ sarvaṃ hi viphalaṃ yasmād yantraṃ tasmānna kārayet

arcane vandane stotre yantrākhyāṃ kathaya prabho tava snehena vaktavyaṃ viśeṣasya viśeṣakam pustikāyāñca gaṅgāyāṃ śivaliṅge prasūnake yantre lakṣaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ mūrtau lakṣaṃ sulocane pustikāyāṃ sahasrantu gaṅgāyāṃ tatsamaṃ phalam puṣpayantre maheśāni pūjanāt sarvasiddhibhāk pramāyāñca pūjāyāṃ na likhed yantramuttamam yantre kṛte mahādevi likhyayantraṃ na kalpayet ekārcane'pyekayantraṃ yantre'pyekārcanaṃ śubham yantrābhāve maheśāna parivārān yajet kutaḥ parivārān yajettatra ghaṭe tu parameśvari suradrumasvarūpo'yaṃ ghaṭo'yaṃ paricintayet patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ dūrvāṃ toyayuktaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyaset tatra pūjā na kartavyā yantrānukalpanaṃ vinā anukalpe sthite yantre pratyakṣañcāpi kalpayet tathā yantre'pi pratyakṣe karaṇīyaṃ parityajet pratyakṣe saṃsthite yantre pratyakṣaṃ naiva kalpayet ādyabījamayī nityā [gh: vidyā] tvāṃ vinā ko vadet priye taddravyaṃ paramaṃ jñātvā taddravyasyānukalpanam saptadaśollāsaḥ śaktidevīṃ vinā devi nānyadevaṃ vicintayet smṛtaḥ] tataśca parameśāni śāktācāraṃ hi bījakam tataśca parameśāni śāktācāraṃ hi bījakam mayoktenaiva mārgeṇa kulakāryaṃ samācaret

gaṇakasya ca saṃsargaṃ sarvadā varjayet priye kāmukānāñca saṃsargaṃ sarvadā parivarjayet satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ tatsaṃsargaṃ parityajet śāktaśca dvividho devi vāmadakṣiṇabhedataḥ sa eva dakṣiṇācāraḥ śivo bhūtvā yajet parām svadharma tadvijānīyāt śrutyuktaṃ parikīrtitam divā ca pāśavaṃ karma rātrau karma ca kīlikam pūjanaṃ lakṣaguṇitaṃ niśāyāṃ nirjane śive niśīthe lakṣaguṇitaṃ pūjayed gopanānvitaḥ niśīthe pañcamenāpi pañcatattvena vārcayet vīrācāramidaṃ proktaṃ sādhakasyāpi bījakam pañcamānandasaṃyuktaḥ pañcatattveṣu lipsitaḥ vīrācāramidaṃ proktaṃ sādhakasyāpi bījakam gopanāt kāryasiddhiḥ syāt prakāśāt siddhidā bhavet ata eva maheśāni prakāśaṃ naiva kārayet gopayecca paśoragre vīrāgre naiva gopayet prakāśāt siddhihāniḥ syād guptāt siddhirna saṃśayaḥ gupte'pi siddhihāniḥ syāt prakāśāt siddhimān bhavet vīrāgre gopanāddevi rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet vīrāgre gopanāt sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ na paśoḥ sannidhāne'pi paśoreva na darśayet gopanīyaṃ paśoragre prakāśānmaraṇaṃ bhavet kena rūpeṇa vā svāmin paśorvīrasya lakṣaṇam iti te prārthitaṃ deva yadi te mayyanugrahaḥ dhūrtaṃ śaṭhaṃ cumbakañca mukharaṃ dāmbhikaṃ śive

anyācārakṛto yena tadvadāmi priyambade [j: varānane] eteṣāṃ jñānamātreṇa kaulikasya kriyākṣayaḥ sa paśuḥ parameśāni pacyate narake dhruvam kadāccinnaiva kartavyaḥ [j: vaktavyam] śūdrasya vedapāṭhavat aṣṭādaśollasaḥ jñāpitaṃ paramānanda mama sthāne prakāśaya tatpānaṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ divya-vīra-paśu-kramāt svecchayāpi paśoḥ pānamiti pānamudāhṛtam paśupānaṃ narakadamiti pānaphalaṃ śṛṇu paśupānamakartavyaṃ śaktibhaktyāśritaḥ pivet kena rūpeṇa vā deva devyagre pānabhāg naraḥ sā svecchā dvividhā jñeyā'jñānijñānivibhedataḥ cakraṃ kṛtvā pivenmadyaṃ cakraṃ hi śaktisaṃyutam phalaṃ kiṃ prāṇanātheśa kathaya [gh: vadaya] siddhihetave j: ṣaṭkarmasya ca sādhanam; ch: ṣaṭkarmaṇo'pi sādhanam] bhogena labhate muktiṃ siddhiṃ śrīcakrasevanāt ekavārajapenaiva lakṣavāraphalaṃ labhet cakrañca dvividhaṃ proktaṃ divya-vīra-mataṃ śive divyacakramidaṃ proktaṃ vīracakraṃ tataḥ śṛṇu ata eva maheśāni śaktiyuktaṃ [j: śaktiyuktaḥ] pivenmadhu vīracakraṃ ramet [gh, j: yajet] śaktiṃ gandhapuṣpādināpi vā divyacakramidaṃ proktaṃ vīracakraṃ tataḥ [ch, j: idaṃ] śṛṇu bhogaśca mokṣaśca karastha eva bhogena madyena karasthamuktiḥ tadā [g: yadā] cakre maheśāni pivenmadyaṃ ramet striyam

śrīcakre'pi pivenmadyaṃ śaktiyuktaṃ maheśvari cottamaṃ madhyamaṃ jñeyaṃ cādhamañcādhamādhamam cakromamidaṃ jñeyaṃ sā kālī sa ca śaṅkaraḥ ekāṃ śaktiṃ samānīya ekaikaḥ sādhakaḥ sadā bhairavī adhamaṃ cakravijñeyaṃ sā sādhyā sa ca sādhakaḥ śaktihīnañca yatcakraṃ kevalaṃ madakaṃ śive madhyame navaśaktiñca hīne'pi śaktimātrakam tasmin cakre sādhako'pi kadācinna praveśayet śrīcakre maithunaṃ bhadraṃ śivatvaṃ yāti sādhakaḥ vīracakramidaṃ proktaṃ devacakraṃ tataḥ śṛṇu sṛṣṭirūpaṃ mahācakraṃ śrīcakraṃ parameśvari iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse unviṃśatyullāsaḥ tatra sthāne careccakraṃ yatra syād devatāgṛha devatāvṛkṣamūleṣu sthānaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ sādhakasya gṛhaṃ bhadre śrīcakrasthānamuttamam athavā yasya yatsthānaṃ tasyājñayā prakalpayet tadudvegasya yatpāpaṃ tatpāpaṃ tatra gacchati śavāsanādhikaṃ jñeyaṃ latāgehapraveśanam yonyabhāve maheśāni trikoṇañcāsanaṃ śubham śavābhāve viṣṭaraṃ hi vīrāsanamudīritam śavaikamāsanaṃ bhadre viṣṭaraṃ yugmamāsanam anyāsanaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ trikoṇaṃ parikalpitam kṛṣṇājine jñānasiddhirmokṣañca vyāghracarmaṇi etadbhinnañcāsanaṃ hi citracitrādi [j: citrācitrādi] saṃyutam

viṣṭaraṃ tatra saṃsthāpya niyataṃ śaktikalpitam praśaste'pyāsane rakte vicitre vā manohare tṛptyarthaṃ devatānāñca kūryādvīrāsanaṃ śive vāmasiddhāntadivyānāṃ svecchāsanamudīritam vāmasiddhāntadivyānāṃ niyamaṃ naiva kalpitam ekānte nirjane ramye deśe vādhāvivarjite rudhireṇa varārohe trikoṇañcāsane [j: āsane] likhet bhūcakramāsanaṃ jñeyaṃ gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ yajedādhāraśaktiñca kamalāntaṃ tridhā śive ājanma koṭyāṃ tanmantraṃ jñāpituṃ naiva śakyate nātinīcaṃ nāti coccaṃ śrīcakre cāsanaṃ priya devatā-guru-bhakto'pi śaktiyuktaḥ kriyānvitaḥ raktānulepairgandhaiśca suveśairbhūṣito guruḥ raktacandanasaṃyukto raktapuṣpavibhūṣitaḥ tadabhāve'pi vaiśyaḥ syānnatu śūdraḥ kadācana teṣāṃ kareṇa pānañcedabhiṣeko bhavet priye madyabhāṇḍaṃ kare kṛtvā cāsane copaveśayet devatādhyānatatparaḥ] ātmapātraṃ śaktikare śrīcakreṣu praveśanam śaktihaste pānapātraṃ svavāme śaktidhāraṇam taccakraṃ parameśāna devacakraṃ na saṃśayaḥ śrīcakreṣu praveśyā sā bhaya-lajjā-vivarjitāḥ dravyaśuddhistu tatkṣaṇāt pātrādvinduṃ samādāya prakṣiped yonimaṇḍale gandhāpuṣpairdhūpadīpaiḥ kāraṇena prapūjayet

ramaṇānte maheśāna bhagavāri pivenmudā śaktiyantraṃ jalaṃ jñeyaṃ yato māyāprabodhakam bhagavārīti toyañca triguṇāktaṃ tridevatā taddehaṃ mama dehañca puṃdehañca sadāśivam sādhakastava tulyo'pi devacakre manohare devacakraṃ devacakraṃ devacakraṃ kalau yuge svecchayā gāna-pānañca maithunañca sukhoditam ata eva maheśāna devacakraṃ kalau yuge iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse viṃśatyullāsaḥ nivṛtte bhairavaucakre sarve varṇāḥ pṛthak pṛthak narake duṣkare ghore patatyeva na saṃśayaḥ caṇḍīkopād bhavennaṣṭaṃ kāntiḥ puṣṭirbalaṃ yaśaḥ maithunasya mahāsaukhyaṃ bījaṃ madyañca sundari madrūpāḥ puruṣāḥ sarve tvadrūpā yoṣitaḥ priye tathā narāśca tiṣṭhanti jātipāśena vandhitāḥ śrīcakre'pi pivenmadyaṃ jātibhedaṃ parityajan sūkṣmasya kena vā naṣṭaṃ cotpattiḥ kena vā punaḥ hrāsavṛddhī na ced jāte ramāyāṃ niśināthavat jātibhraṣṭasya kāntāpi madhyabhuk ramaṇī śive pūjayettāṃ maheśāni ramaṇaṃ naiva kārayet śrīcakre parameśāni jātipāśaṃ parityajet vṛthāpānaṃ bhavettasya kevalaṃ jātināśakam nānāvyañjanasaṃyuktamannaṃ saṃsthāpya yatnataḥ bhakṣaṇañca viśeṣañca sandeśaṃ vividhaṃ priye śrīcakre sthāpayeddevi devatātṛptihetave

tataśca dhūpa-patrāṇi śrīcakre viniyojayet paramānnañca takrañca suvāsita-jalaṃ priye ghṛtena jñāvitaṃ māṃsaṃ vividhaṃ sthāpayet priye laśūnaṃ śrīcakramadhye sthāpayedārdrakaṃ priye lājāṃścipiṭakañcaiva śrīcakre viniyojayet paṅktyākāre cakramadhye sthāpayet parameśvari śodhitaṃ vidhivat sarvaṃ paṅktyākāre niyojayet iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse ekaviṃśatyullāsaḥ śāntike puṣṭike [j: pauṣṭike] kārye rājataṃ kārayet priye sarvakāryeṣu kartavyaṃ viśvāmitraṃ kuleśvari abhedasthitapātrakam] tatrādhārantu saṃsthāpya śrīpātraṃ sthāpayettataḥ padasaṃkhyāñca koṇañca maṇḍalaṃ kārayet priye idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvajñānañca tadvada sattvaguṇāśrayāḥ] tattvajñānaprasādena śambhuḥ saṃhārakārakaḥ tattvajñānaṃ vinā devi muktirhāsyāya kalpate śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi tattvaṃ parama durlabham madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā matsyaṃ mudrāñca maithunaṃ śive aiśvaryaṃ paramaṃ hṛṣṭaṃ madya-pānena śailaje matsyabhojanamātreṇa kālīpratyakṣatā bhavet maithunena mahāyogī mama tulyo na saṃśayaḥ dvitīyena ca tattvena mahābhairavatāṃ vrajet pareṇa paratāṃ yāti tava [gh, j: mama] tulyoḥ na saṃśayaḥ asya bhāvaṃ phalaṃ kiñca pañcadhāpyekadhā ca kim

kāryaṃ nānāmataṃ yasya nānārūpaṃ hi kāraṇam astrasya kāraṇaṃ lauhaṃ lauhasyāstraṃ hi kāraṇam kāryabhede kāraṇasya devi bhedaṃ hi kalpanam matsyamāṃsasadāḥ] jīvanmuktāśca te devi brāhmaṇāśca na cānyathā tathaiva tattvasevāyāṃ līyate paramātmani yena vijñānamātreṇa mokṣasiddhirna saṃśayaḥ toyaṃ vinā yathā nāsti pipāsānāśakāraṇam vinā vahniprayogeṇa yathā kiñcinna pacyate tattvajñānaṃ vinā devi tathā muktirna jāyate iti śrīsarvānandanātha viracite sarvollāse dvāviṃśatyullāsaḥ adhunā śrotumicchāmi tattvādyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ mahat bījaṃ vinānyatattvaṃ yat diṅmūḍhasyāpi pūrvavat amṛtaṃ bhogamāpanne mṛtabhāvaṃ vimuhyitāḥ [j: vimuhyati] surāñca [j: surāyāḥ] bhogamāpanne suratvañca bhaviṣyati mahāśaktiḥ puṣparūpā maithunaṃ phalarūpakam tatkṣaṇāt śivarūpo'sau satyaṃ satyaṃ priyambade ata eva hi vipraśca surāpānaṃ sadācaret [gh, j: samācaret] brahmajñānaṃ yadā devi tadā brāhmaṇa ucyate tathaiva sadyabhug vipro līyate paramātmani vedasya varjitaṃ madyaṃ kathamuktaṃ sadāśiva ata eva kriyāśaktairmadyaṃ tyājyaṃ yuge yuge bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca te narā brahmarākṣasāḥ tathāpi brāhmaṇāḥ sarve madyapāneṣu lālitāḥ sa mahāpātakī caiva vedādiṣu nirūpaṇam

vṛthāpāne mahāpāpaṃ sarvaśāstrasya sammataḥ vāyunā jvalito'gniśca vāyunā layavān yathāṃ tatpānaṃ kāraṇaṃ pānaṃ tadanyad viṣabhakṣaṇam tenaiva viṣakhaṇḍena viṣaṃ nāśayate bhiṣak muktyākāṃkṣī pivenmadyaṃ tadanyaḥ pātakī bhavet śodhitañcedaśuddhañcet svargaṃ narakadāyakam muktyarthe kāraṇaṃ pānaṃ jñānārthe'pi maheśvari iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse trayoviṃśatyullāsaḥ hetorabhāve śrīcakraṃ pūrṇānandaṃ nacet kvacit anyaddravyaṃ hi śrīcakre śaktivākyānusārataḥ cakreśvarīṃ striyaṃ kṛtvā kāryakarmāṇi cācaret uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ jñeyaṃ cādhamaṃ parikīrtitam parikīrtitam tasyottamañcādhamañca madhyamaṃ kena tadvada tathā doṣo nāsti hetoḥ karaṇīyasya doṣajam śukrapāte yathā doṣaṃ kāraṇasya tathā śive sādhakasya kriyābhedāttāvubhau doṣabhāginau tathāpi rogiṇo dehe tajjalaṃ duḥkhadāyakam parameśvari] madyeṣu śaktau doṣo'sti kevalājñānino vacaḥ ajñānasya kriyāmūlaṃ kriyāyāḥ śuddhamūlakaṃ tatrāpi śaktisaṃyuktaṃ madyaṃ kaivalyadāyakam jñānabhāk kāraṇāsaktastasmānmadyaṃ pivenmudā śodhitau cet yonimadvyau sarvapāpapraṇāśakau śuddhābhāve'pyaśuddhakam

pāne'pi narakaṃ yāti ramaṇaṃ maraṇaṃ bhavet śaktijñānaṃ kāraṇena tataḥ śaktiñca śodhayet śaktyai datvā pivenmadyaṃ śuddhiṃ kuryāt krameṇa ca śodhayitāpi tāṃ śaktiṃ śrīcakreṣu praveśayet paśuśaktiñca kāṃ proktāṃ mama sthāne prakāśaya prathame puṣpitā nārī ubhayoḥ pūjitā parā ata eva mahādevi sapuṣpā vīrapūjitā puṣpitāpi paśoḥ pūjyā paśuñced vāñchitā yadi śaktirūpā mahāśaktau ramaṇārthe gṛhe sthitā kuryārcane śive] śodhitāṃ yonimāśritya ramed vīrastadantataḥ vīrāṇāṃ pañcatattvena retasā kevalena vā pūjāhīnā ca yā nārī japahīnā ca yā punaḥ bhrāntistatra na kartavyā yadi muktiñca kāṃkṣatiḥ vīparītena toṣaṇāt pañcagavyena saṃśuddhiṃ ramaṇañcācaret tataḥ śukrāktarūdhireṇaiva pūjayediṣṭadevatām iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse caturviṃśatyullāsaḥ śodhitaṃ tatparaṃ madyaṃ pāpanāśakaraṃ param tatpānaṃ parameśāni kevalaṃ duḥkhadāyakam śuddhaṃ kṛtvā pivenmadyaṃ devatāprītipūrvakam sanmukhe vāmabhāge vā maṇḍalaṃ caturasrakam svakīyavāmabhāge tu ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vindumadhyagam daśakaletipadaṃ dattvā [ch: kṛtvā] tadante cātmane namaḥ kalase pūjayedvīraḥ sakalaṃ sūryamaṇḍalam

dvādaśeti padaṃ dattvā namo'nte'pi kalātmane tatastu kāraṇaṃ divyaṃ ghaṭe'pi sthāpayettataḥ vibhāvya manasā mantrī pūjayedbahuyatnataḥ khaṇḍitaṃ sphuṭitaṃ bhagnaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ parityajet tāmraṃ vā bhūmayaṃ vāpi kevalaṃ lauhavarjitam tatra madhye yajed vīraḥ sakalaṃ somamaṇḍalam ṣoḍaśeti padaṃ dattvā namo'nte'pi kalātmane pradarśeyeddhenumudrāṃ vaṃ varṇena ca sādhakaḥ hsauḥ hkṣau/ namo jñātvā hsauḥ saṃlikhya kāraṇe halakṣañca likhet koṇe hsauḥ hkṣau/ tasya [j: ca] madhyage eka - śaktau mahādeva dviliṅgaṃ kena saṃyutam sa-kāraṃ sthūlaliṅgaśca hakārasyāpi madhyagam svareṇa ṣoḍaśenāpi kalā ṣoḍaśa varddhitā hsauḥ mantramidaṃ proktaṃ visargaḥ karmabhāṣitaḥ tatra madhye mahāliṅgaṃ hakārasyāpi śeṣakam caturdaśa svaraṃ jñeyamubhayoḥ karāpādakam visargaḥ parameśāni kāmātmānaṃ vicintayet anayoḥ sūkṣmatā yatra praṇavo'bhūccaturdaśaḥ tatramadhye mahāśūnyaṃ praṇavaṃvedabhāṣitam adhunā śrotumicchāmi hkṣau/ mantrasya lakṣaṇam ṣakāraṃ rajobhāvena ha-kāraṃ rajobhāṣitam sattvaṃ rajastamo jñeyamekaśaktestridhā parā [j: strikāraṇam] kacodbhavāṃ brahmahatyāṃ tena tenāśayāmyaham amāvījamaye devi śukraśāpādvimucyatām tena satyena te devi brahmahatyāṃ vyapohatu

kṛṣṇaśāpaṃ śukraśāpaṃ brahmaśāpaṃ vimocayet tataśca bījaṃ madyaṃ hi tatra śāpaṃ kathaṃ vada śaktihīne madyapāne śukro brahmā janārdanaḥ tataśca parameśāni śāpaṃ tyajya pivenmadhu śāpādimocanaṃ dravyaṃ devānāmapi durlabham mocanārthe tridhā mantraṃ daśadhā kāraṇe japet dravyamadhye gandhapiṣpairyajed vīrastrivārakam iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse pañcaviṃśatyullāsaḥ dhyānaṃ me paramānandaṃ kathaya prāṇavallabha aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ devaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam vṛṣāruḍhaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam pāśāṅkuśadharaṃ devaṃ gadāmusaladhāriṇam vibhrataṃ tomaraṃ muṇḍaṃ varadābhayapāṇikam iti dhyātvā dravyamadhye yajedānandabhairavam bhairavī madyasaṃrupā bhairavānandarupakaḥ himamundendudhavalāṃ pañcavaktrāṃ trilocanām grahasantīṃ viśālākṣīṃ devadevasya sammukhīm trivāraṃ pūjayeddevīṃ guṇatrayavibhedataḥ teṣāṃ madhye sādhako'pi kena vā sādhanañcaret prativarṇaṃ vinduyuktaṃ bindunāda vibhūṣitam vilikhet trikoṇākāramakathādi [j: trikoṇarupam] krameṇa tu ha la kṣaṃ tattrikoṇeṣu brahma viṣṇu śivātmakam kasmin koṇe vaset śambhuḥ kathaya prāṇavallabhe antyakoṇe mahādevaḥ prakṛtyāpyekadehakaḥ nādabindumayaṃ pīṭhaṃ dravyamadhye likhedbudhaḥ

likhitvā cintayeddravyaṃ mṛtabhāva-vivarjitam saptavārajapenaiva dravyaśuddhistu tatkṣaṇāt iti śrīsarvānandanātha viracite sarvollāse ṣaḍviṃśatyullāsaḥ ubhayoḥ kāraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ guṇatrayamahat [j: -mayaṃ] param kapotakasya chāgasya kūrmasya parameśvari ānīya tāni yatnena devyāḥ santuṣṭahetave ānīya tāni yatnena devyai coddiśya ghātayet anyathā ghātanāddevi rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet pitṛdaivatayajñeṣu prāṇihiṃsā vidhīyate viṣame durgame ghore etatyeva na saṃśayaḥ devatārthe dvijārthe vā hatvā pāpairna lipyate devatārthe dvijārthe vā hatvā pāpairnalipyate pañcatattvasya māhātmyaṃ phalañca pañcadhā yataḥ trivāraṃ paṭhanāt mantraṃ māṃsaśuddhistu tatkṣaṇāt yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣvadhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā sadgurañcaiva vodālaṃ rohitaṃ cottamaṃ priye śodhitaṃ cet pradātavyaṃ śaktivaktre maheśvari tasmāt praśastakaṃ jñeyaṃ dagdhaṃ hi varavarṇini śaktivaktre pradātavyaṃ kāraṇena samanvitam urvārukamiva bandhanān mṛtyormukṣīyamāmṛtāt trivāraṃ paṭhanānmantraṃ mīnaśuddhistu tatkṣaṇāt yonipadmakadambeti lakṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitam iti mudrā śodhitaṃ cet devyāḥ prītikarā parā iti mudrā kṛtā saṃjñā mahāmodapradāyinī mantradvayaṃ tridhā japtvā mudrāśuddhistu tatkṣaṇāt

cakṣurātam paramaṃ padam iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvvollāse saptaviṃśatyullāsaḥ vinā śaktiṃ na siddhyeta tasmāt śaktiṃ samāśrayet tatra sthitā devatātmā sā śaktiḥ sarvapūjitā tataśca sādhakaḥ śreṣṭho mūṣayedbahubhūṣaṇaiḥ gurubhaktiratāṃ devi kulasādhanatatparām ānīya bahuyatnena jātibhedaṃ na cācaret athavā pānasaṃhṛṣṭāṃ cakramadhye samānayet athavā strīsamīpe vā yantraṃ kṛtvā prapūjayet tatsamīpe kṛtaṃ yantraṃ tadājñābhāvamānataḥ kāmarūpāt śataguṇaṃḥ samudīritamavyayam kulaniṣṭhaśca vipraśca tasyāḥ śuddhiṃ na cācaret śodhayet paraśaktiñca dvitvātmaikatvahetave gaṅgāyāmanadhaṃ] yathā śaktiśuddhiḥ prakartavyā yadaikātmā na cet śive ātmaśuddhe [j: ātmaśuddhiḥ] śaktiśuddhistasya siddhidūrataḥ śakterdoṣaṃ tadā kutra svayaṃ tatraiva saṃlayaḥ tasya śuddhiḥ kathaṃ bhadre manasā cintanaṃ [g: cintaya] yadi jāhnavī yamunā vāṇī [g: vāri] sadā bhātīti jñānataḥ sāśuddhiśced bhaveddeva tadāśuddhiśca devatā manasā cet na śuddhiḥ syānmantraśuddhiḥ sudūrataḥ pūrṇacakraṃ nacet tatra pūrṇānandaṃ naced yataḥ praṇamya devatāvuddhyā bhogapātraṃ pradāpayet uccastanīṃ kāmaratāṃ vidhavāñca prapūjayet

tasyā yoniṃ laṅghayitvā tattvaṃ devyai nivedayet ubhau ca duḥkhau parame paśupāśaniyantritau śukrapātaṃ prakartavyaṃ tasyā vākyānusārataḥ tāvacca ramaṇaṃ kuryāt patanānte parityajet nivedya kāraṇāktaṃ hi bhakṣayenmanunā śive iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse aṣṭāviṃśatyullāsaḥ tasyā dīkṣā kathaṃ proktā vidhavā vā kathaṃ vada ānandena bhavet pūjyā sānandā vīravanditā dīkṣitā sadhavā jñeyā yadyānandasamāśritā śivo'hamiti saṃjñātvā śrīcakreṣu ramet śivām ātmaśuddhe jagat śuddhamaśuddhe cāpyaśuddhakam ātmā'śuddhe'pyaśuddhā sā sphāṭike rañjanaṃ yathā śakterdoṣaṃ mahādevi gṛhṇāti naiva sādhakaḥ śakterdoṣaṃ na cācaret tāsāṃ prahāraṃ nindāñca kauṭilyamapriyantathā striyo devāḥ striyaḥ prāṇā eva vibhūṣaṇam taddhastāvacitaṃ puṣpaṃ taddhastāvacitaṃ jalam mahācīnadrumalatāveṣṭitaḥ sādhakottamaḥ mahācīnadrumalatāveṣṭanena ca yatphalam śavāsanādhikaphalaṃ latāgehe praveśanam kāmānandaṃ vinā devi bhogamuktirna jāyate śaktiśuddhirna kartavyā yataḥ sveṣṭamayī priye sindūrarañjitāṃ kṛtvā mūlamantraṃ likhed bhage mantradīkṣaḥ vidhānena śaktiśuddhistu tatkṣaṇāt pūjayitvā maheśāni bhogapātraṃ pradāpayet

raktapuṣpeṇa nirmañjya [gh: nirmajya] yonideśe niyojayet mama śaktiṃ kuru dvandvaṃ svāheti daśadhā japet bhogapātraṃ yadā deyaṃ tadā ramaṇamācaret tenaiva manunā devi ṣaḍaṅge [gh, j: ṣaḍaṅgaṃ] nyāsamācaret saptatirmantritaṃ kṛtvā pūtaṃ sarvaṃ bhaved dhruvam juhuyāt kuṇḍalīvaktre mūlamantreṇa sundari bhogakāle maheśāni ājihvāntaṃ vibhāvayet mūlamantraṃ samuccārya juhuyāt kuṇḍalīmukhe bhojanecchā bhavettasyā nirlipto jīvasaṃjñakaḥ prayāti narakaṃ ghoramekaviṃśakulaiḥ saha guruṃ smaran pivenmadyaṃ khādan māṃsaṃ na doṣabhāk iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse ūnatriṃśadullāsaḥ kāraṇasya kāraṇaṃ hi sambideti prakalpitam kasmāt pānaṃ kāraṇaṃ hi sambidānandabhāk naraḥ bhāvāktaṃ sambidānandaṃ madyānandamabhedakam bhāvānandeṣu deveśi muktibhāg jāyate naraḥ tadā kaivalyamuktiḥ syāt satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ idaṃ jñānaṃ sambidotthaṃ muktyarthamubhayānvitam sadānanda] pradāyakam ata eva mahādeva sambidāgrahaṇañcaret sarvadā parameśāna siddhyānandaṃ kvacit kvacit madyānandaṃ kvacid deva parvaṇi madhupānayuk śukle yadi pivenmadyaṃ ādyante sambidāṃ pivet śukle cādyaṃ pivet siddhiṃ kṛṣṇe cādyaṃ pivenmadhu tvaritāyāstamodbhūtamityānandasya lakṣaṇam

rājasīti kriyāśaktastāmasīti kriyācyutaḥ tathā siddhiṃ vinā devi madyānandaṃ hi niścitam tataḥ śaktiṃ yajeccakre tataḥ siddhiṃ pivenmudā ata eva pivet siddhiṃ śaktiyukto maheśvari tadante śaktisaṃyukte sambidā samayā bhavet svecchācāre'pi ramaṇaṃ niṣedhavidhivarjitam śivodbhavaṃ yadā dravyaṃ śaktiḥ saṃhṛhya yatnataḥ ihaloke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante paramāṃ gatim yaḥ karoti trisandhāyāyāṃ mama tulyo na saṃśayaḥ sambidāsavayormadhye sambideva garīyasī tadā dhyānamayī mūrtiḥ pratyakṣā bhavati dhruvam samvidāsavayormadhye samvideva garīyasī dhyānena dhyeyaṃ yadrūpaṃ samvidā nitya [j: mukti] dāyikā kriyāmārgī kriyāśaktaḥ śuddhe'pi vijayāṃ pivet oṃ brahmāṇyai [gh, j: brāhmaṇyai] namaḥ svāhā oṃ kṣatriyāyai namaḥ svāhā hrī/ vaiśyāyai namaḥ svāhā klīṃ [ch: hrī/] śūdrāyai namaḥ svāhā ullāsānandini kande cidānandasvarūpiṇi manonmani madhu drākṣā khecarī vijayā jayā mūlañca daśadhā japtvā juhuyāt kuṇḍalīmukhe svamūrddhani pradātavyaṃ manunā ca pivenmudā samvidā paramā vidyā bhogamokṣapradā śivā prāṇavallabha sādhakānāṃ sādhanārthe svayaṃ jātyabhisaṃyutā

jñānināṃ jñānabhedena nānārūpā ca samvidā dūṣaṇaṃ hi phalāktasya guṇaṃ jñeyaṃ hi tasya tu lakṣaṇaṃ hi tathā stotraṃ mama sthāne prakāśaya anyathā samvidāṃ vidyāṃ pivedānandahetave puṣpabhedena deveśi jātibhedaṃ vicintayet karmanaṣṭe jātinaṣṭe'pi muktibhāk sitayātha guḍenāpi pakvaiḥ kadalikairapi tena sarveṇa vijayāṃ svīkuryāt sādhakottamaḥ mahātejaskarī cakṣurdoṣādikavināśinī ghṛtena madhunā dhatte vāgdevīvaśakāriṇī pittadoṣān śleṣmadoṣān madhunā saha nāśayet sitayātha guḍenaiva śūlaghnī pittanāśinī āmavātasamudbhūtagrahaṇīvinivāriṇī valapuṣṭipradā caiva madhurasvaradāyinī prakāśitaṃ tava snehāt sarvāgameṣu [k: savatantreṣu] gopitam gurumantraṃ samuccārya caturthyantaṃ nivedayet iṣṭadevasya tanmantraṃ prajapan viharet kṛtī tejasvī valavān vāgmī medhāvī priyadarśanaḥ bhaviṣyati na sandeho dravyasyāsya niṣevaṇāt samvit prayogastenaiva kartavyaḥ sādhakottamaḥ tolakambā dvitolambā tolakatrayameva vā tasmāt pramāṇamātrāhi kartavyā siddhimicchatā prasādādacirādasyāḥ siddhirbhavati vāñchitā devi tvayāpi vidhinā pravidhīyatāṃ tat etāni samabhāgāni raudre śuṣkāṇi cūrṇayet

ubhayośca samāṃ datvā sitāṃ tanmiśrayed dṛḍham punaḥ śilātale piṣṭvā trisugandhiñca miśrayet caturbhirmantrabhistāsāṃ śodhanaṃ samupācaret mantrasiddhistathā pūjājapasiddhirvarānane satyaṃ satyuṃ maheśāni satyameva na saṃśayaḥ ekoccāraṇamātreṇa tāvacca [gh: bhavecca] lakṣakoṭayaḥ yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ iti satyaṃ kuru priye iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse triṃśadullāsaḥ ādhāre sthāpayet pātraṃ mṛtsthitaṃ mṛtyudāyakam athavā vartulākāraṃ trikoṇaṃ tripadānvitam viśvāmitramayañca kāmadamidaṃ haimaṃ tathā sphāṭikam ādhāraṃ sthāpayettatra pātraṃ tasyopari nyaset pittalaṃ kāṃsyasambhūtaṃ matsyañcaiva ca pārvati rājatañca varārohe sarvarogavināśanam putravṛddhikaraṃ proktaṃ mauktikaṃ parameśvari pittalaṃ sarvadoṣaghnaṃ tāmrajaṃ kīrtivarddhanam nṛkapālaṃ mahāpālaṃ sarvakārye praśastakam śāntike prastaraṃ pātraṃ stambhane mṛnmayaṃ śive viśvāmitraṃ mahāpātraṃ sarvakāryeṣu durlabham matsyañca parameśvari] kāryabhede pātrabhedaṃ kuryāt sādhaka īśvari nṛ kapālasamudbhūtaṃ pātraṃ śuddhaṃ prakīrtitam tatkapālakṛtaṃ pātraṃ sarvaṃ tasya vṛthā bhavet tasya muṇḍaṃ svayaṃ chedya mahāpātraṃ prakalpayet tasya muṇḍodbhavaṃ pātraṃ mahāpātraṃ prakīrtitam

mahāpātrakṛto rājā yataḥ śāstā maheśvari mama prītikaraṃ pātraṃ sādhakaprītidāyakam tvāṃ vinā tasya māhātmyaṃ ko vetti jagatītale aśodhitaṃ hi yat pātraṃ kevalaṃ duḥkhadāyakam yonyaśuddhe maheśāni pātramātre'pyuśuddhakam sarvaṃ śuddhaṃ bhaveddevi yonijñānaṃ bhaved yadi pūrayet [gh: pūjayet] kāraṇenāpi mūlena guruvākyataḥ pūritāni maheśāni kāraṇena maheśvari iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse ekatriṃśadullāsaḥ sthāpayet sarvapātrāṇi sāmānyārghakrameṇa tu sthāpitāni ca pātrāṇi pūrayet kāraṇena tu pūrvādyaṃ cottarāgraṃ vā divārātrau vibhedataḥ uttarāyantu saṃsthāpya paścimāgraṃ maheśvari uttarāgraṃ paścimāgraṃ niśācakraṃ cared [gh: yajed] yadi tripātraṃ parameśāni sthāpayenmanunā śive yoginī valipātrañca śaktipātraṃ maheśvari pātraṃ navamamityuktaṃ caturvargaphalapradam yoginī vīrapātrañca valipādyaṃ hi saptamam yoginī - valipātrañca pañcapātraṃ maheśvari tripātrāṇi ca kartavyamekapātraṃ na kārayet mantrastasya vṛthā jñeyaḥ śaktikāryaṃ vṛthā yataḥ niṣedhañca vidhiñcaiva vāmāyāṃ nāsti ced yataḥ gurūpātrodbhavaṃ madyamekapātraṃ pivenmudā tāvanmadyaṃ pived bhakto yāvat pānaṃ kramāt krmāt pañcapātramidaṃ matam

pādyamācamanīyañca navamaṃ parikīrtitam śaktaye bhogapātrañca pūjāpātrād yajet śivām śaktimātre śaktipātraṃ vīrāya vīrapātrakam śrīpātrādamṛtenanāpi yajedarghādinā priye bhogārthaṃ bhogapātrañca śaktaye ca pradāpayet vaṭukakṣetrapālebhyo valipātraṃ nivedayet pādyapātraṃ pade [gh: dadet] devyā mukhe ācamanīyakam kāraṇaṃ hi bhavet kāryaṃ śrīdevyāścaraṇāmbuje mṛtabhāvaṃ parityajyāpyamaraḥ sādhako bhavet ataśca sādhakāḥ sarve dadeyuḥ kāraṇaṃ mukhe tadante sādhako devi [j: parameśāni] pivedoṣṭhādharaṃ madhu nārīdehasaṃśritāhamamṛtapānamāśritā yathā dehasya duḥkhe'pi dehī bhavati duḥkhabhāk sādhakasyāpi muktyarthaṃ pānāktā kāmukānvitā parā śrīkālikārūpā [j: strī-] śrīcakrapālane varā varābhayakarā ghorārāvayuktā vibhūṣaṇā nagnā mattā mahādevī siṃhapṛṣṭhe śavāsanā lakṣa lakṣa samāyuktā śrīcakraṃ pālayet sadā darśane ghrāṇasaṃsparśe pānānandapradāyikā kṛpānvitā] iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse dvātriṃśadullāsaḥ sarvadevā na tṛpyanti smaraṇāt pūjanāt śive sarvadravyasamāyuktaṃ manunā pātrakaṃ dadet kapilānte jaṭābhāra bhāsurānte trinetra ca vahnijāyānvito mantro vaṭukasya udāhṛtaḥ

śāntiṃ karotu me nityaṃ bhūtavetālasevitaḥ bhyaḥ svāhā sarvavarṇānte yoginīpadamālikhet anena manunā devi yoginīnāṃ balirbhavet khecarīṣu bhūcarīṣu sā me prītāstu sarvadā sthānakṣetrapadaṃ pānadhūpadīpādi cālikhet vahnijāyānvito mantraḥ kṣetrapālasya sundari prīto'yaṃ balidānena sarvarakṣāṃ karotu me varānte varadānte ca sarvānte janamālikhet vahnijāyānvito mantro gaṇeśasya valiṃ haret pātālatalasaṃsthāśca śivayogena bhāṣitāḥ tṛpyantu prītimanaso bhūtā gṛhṇantvimāṃ balim yasya nāma pradātavyaṃ taddevo valimicchati gṛhṇa yugmaṃ dvidhāntoyaṃ manuḥ sarvaphalapradam rājarājeśvaro devo me prasīdatu sarvadā dakṣāṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ yoginīnāntu kathyate anayā mudrayā devi kṣetrapālavalirbhavet rājarājeśvarī devo me prasīdatu sarvadā kuladīpaṃ vinā bhadre jñānadīpaṃ nacet kvacit nivedyaṃ kena rūpeṇa kathaya prāṇavallabha dīpān ḍamarukārāñca bṛddhasya nakhamānataḥ śatānyūne maheśāni yugmānyaṃ dīpa kalpanam dīpasaṃkhyāṃ paribhrāmya svatejastejasi layam śataṃ deyaṃ divā kārye kulaniṣṭhaśca sādhakaḥ tridhā devyagre saṃbhrāmya kuladīpaṃ nivedayet āraktakāmadaṃ dīpaṃ gṛhāṇa mama siddhaye

pañcamaṃ saptamaṃ vāpi navamaṃ vā viśeṣakam tataḥ śaktiṃ yajet cakre yayā śaktyāyutaḥ śive [gh: priye] svaśaktiṃ paraśaktiṃ vā dīkṣitāñced yajet śivām triśūlamudrayā gṛhya pivedācāryavākyataḥ pṛthak pātraṃ pradātavyaṃ madhunā saha bhairavi bhairavāya pradātavyaṃ bhaktāya sevakāya ca prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā gṛhṇīyāt pātramuttamam svavidyokta ṛṣinyāsaṃ vyāpakanyāsameva ca tataḥ pātraṃ namaskṛtya juhuyāt kuṇḍalīmukhe iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse tritriṃśadullāsaḥ atisūkṣmatamanāmnaḥ prāṇāyāmasya kiṃ phalam pañcāśanmanunā devi varṇanyāsaṃ samācaret karanyāse karaṃ jñeyaṃ devasya karamātrakam varṇanyāse maheśāni deho devamayo bhavet so'haṃ jñānena deveśi ṛṣyahaṃ paricintayet taddehaṃ devatārūpaṃ so'haṃ jñānaṃ sadā yadā saptadhā nyāsajālena saptaite devarūpiṇaḥ saptadhā mantrayenmantrī kyāpakanyāsakaṃ śive bhaktyāpi yaddīyamānaṃ tad gṛhṇāti kuleśvari ādhāre manunā sthāpya tarpayet tadanantaram guruśaktiṃ tarpayitvā sveṣṭadevīñca tarpayet gurorājñānusāreṇa tacchaktiramaṇañcaret gurorājñānusāreṇa pātraṃ dattvā kriyāñcaret vivāhaṃ bandhanaṃ jñeyaṃ vartistho vahnivat priye tasya vāme nārīmātraṃ ramaṇañca tadājñayā

tadājñayā ramet śaktiṃ mātṛbhāvaṃ parityajet śrīguroścaraṇaṃ dhyāyan svamūrdhni gurupādukām ānandabhairavaṃ devaṃ sveṣṭavidyāṃ hi tarpayet sahasrāre sveṣṭavidyāsahitaṃ tarpayed gurum abhede tarpayed bhadre [ch, j: bhadraṃ] sahasrāre mahāpure ataśca tarpayeddevān tāntrike vaidikeṣu ca śrīpādukāṃ tarpayāmi pūjayāmīti vā priye parameṣṭhiguruṃ devi tarpayet tritrivārakam parāparaguruḥ ko vā parameṣṭhiguruśca kaḥ nānārūpaṃ sthūlamātraṃ yathāgniḥ kāṣṭhasaṃyutaḥ aikyaṃ kṛtvā sthūlasūkṣmaṃ sarvametat prakāśitam parāparagurustvaṃ hi parameṣṭhigururhyaham savāhanāṃ sveṣṭadevīṃ tarpayāmi dvidhāantakaḥ tarpayeccet kriyāsaṅgād guruṇā saha bhāvinīm śvetavarṇā dvibhujāktā dvinetrā tatsamāyutam tatsaṃyuktaṃ guruṃ dhyāyet tarpaṇādikamācaret aṃguṣṭhatarjanīyogād dakṣiṇe [j: dakṣeṇa] puṣpapātanam anayoryogamātreṇa dravyaṃ puṣpaṃ manoharam aṃguṣṭhayogāt sā devī puṣpitā kāmavihvalā tarpayed yonimadhye tu yoniṃ saṃgṛhya tatparam bindumātreṇa dravyeṇa tuṣṭā bhavati kāminī tarpaṇādi prakartavyaṃ jalamāyā sanātanī tathā toyaṃ sarvapūjyaṃ sarvasya bandhamuktidam tarpayed jñānavān devi svamūrdhni hṛdaye ca vā guṇatrayasya caikatve tarpaṇaṃ caikavārakam

iti śrīsarvānandanātha viracite sarvollāse catustriṃśadullāsaḥ triśūlamudrayā gṛhya pratipātreṣu vandanam pratipātraṃ śuddhiyuktaṃ surādevīṃ vicintayet pare vāme kare sthāpya surādevīñca prārthayet amṛtaṃ satyalokeṣu svargalokeṣu kāraṇam ānandatvaṃ sevanācca muktitvaṃ ramaṇīyutāt pātrañca navamaṃ devi vandanīyaṃ pivenmadhu saṃkhyāvirahitaṃ pātraṃ kevalaṃ mṛtyudāyakam tasya mantro vṛthā devi pānaṃ narakadāyakam ata ūrddhaṃ maheśāni niyamaḥ kaḥ kṣamo bhavet niyamañcaret; j: tāvanna niyamañcaret] vandanīyaṃ kramāt [ch, j: krame] kuryānniyamena pivenmadhu vande śrīprathamaṃ karāmbu jagataṃ pātraṃ viśuddhipradam ājihvāntaṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ dhyātvā pānaṃ carenmadhu śuddhiṃ kṛtvā [g, gh, c: dhṛtvā] maheśāni caṣake viniyojayet kulakuṇḍalinī-vaktre dattvā dhyāyed guruṃ svayam [j: śive] mūlena kuṇḍalī vaktre dattvā brahma nirūpaṇam vande pātramahaṃ dvitīyamadhunānandaikasamvarddhanam cātmāvabodhakṣamam tadante ramaṇaṃ kuryānmūlamantrajapānvitam pañcapātrayutaṃ cakraṃ vandanaṃ śṛṇu pārvati pāyāt pañcamakāratattvasahitaṃ pātraṃ caturthaṃ namaḥ rādityapramukhaiḥ surāsuragaṇairājñākaraiḥ kiṅkaraiḥ yatkṛtvā [gh: kṛte] sādhakaśreṣṭhaḥ śivatulyo na saṃśayaḥ tatpātraṃ prathamaṃ samastajagatāṃ saukhyāya vande sadā

lokānāṃ śubhavṛddhidāyakamidaṃ pātraṃ dvitīyaṃ namaḥ pāyāt pañcamakāratattvasahitaṃ pātraṃ tṛtīyaṃ namaḥ tatpātrañca samastapuṇyasukhadaṃ pātraṃ caturthaṃ namaḥ pītabrahmarasaṃ sadodyatakaraṃ pātraṃ bhaje pañcakam śrīmat sundarī tarpaṇaṃ dravarasaṃ pātrañca ṣaṣṭhaṃ bhaje pātraṃ saptamapūraṇe bhavabhayānando'dhikaḥ pātu mām pātrañcāṣṭamamaṣṭasiddhikaraṇaṃ prauḍha prasannaṃ sadā pātraṃ yannavanāthaśaktisahitaṃ sarvārthasiddhipradam iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvvollāsepañcatriṃśadullāsaḥ vikalpo nātra kartavyaḥ kṛte ca maraṇaṃ bhavet dīyamānaṃ mahāmantraṃ kathayāmi śṛṇu priye svīkṛtya subhage devi jayaṃ dehi punaḥ punaḥ svapātre kāraṇe miśraṃ pivedānandahetave śaktirūpā mahādevī kevalānandavarddhinī sādhakasya kriyānande tejīyo rūpadhāriṇī tathā nārī narasyāpi sarvakāryaprakāśikā [ch, j: prakāśinī] svīkṛtya kāraṇaṃ devi paścāt kāryāṇi sādhayet prāṇāyāmaṃ gṛtīye ca caturthe japamāharet pañcamaṃ pātrasahitaṃ cakrasya lakṣaṇaṃ śive maithunaṃ parameśāni daśamānandamācaret nādabindumayaṃ pīṭhaṃ haṃsayugmaṃ prakāśitam hṛdaye cintayeddevaṃ dvibhujaṃ śaktisaṃyutam saccit sukhābhīṣṭavarāpradānam mandasmitaṃ pūrṇakṛpānidhānam śrīdguruṃ nityamahaṃ namāmi

dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ sahasrāre prakalpayet dadācit hṛdayāmbhoje kadācid dṛṣṭigocare tvadīya prativimbeṣu tajjñānaṃ paricintanam pratibimbasya bimbaṃ hi naradehaprakāśakam sthūlasya vimbaṃ paramaṃ tejasi bhāti sarvadā tanmanaḥ parameśāni mano'tītaṃ nirañjanam vācātītaṃ vacojñeyaprakāśaṃ [j: vācā-] prakāśakam tatprakāśe jagadbhāti nābhāti cāprakāśake śiva śaktimayaṃ bindu sahasrāraṃ manoharam pratibindu nādayugmaṃ nādañca binduyugmakam nādabindumayaṃ sarvaṃ brahmajñānena bhāṣitam nādāktabindu jñeyañca brahmajñānamiti priye mahāśṛṅgārasaṃyuktā jīvātma mokṣadāyikā maṇipureṣu tāṃ devīṃ [g: nītvā] cintāmaṇi vibhūṣayet pūjayed vahuyatnena kāraṇādiprabhedakaiḥ viśuddhākhye japenmantramājñāyāṃ tatsamāpanam śivaśaktimayaṃ bindumekadehaṃ vicintayet śivaśaktimayaṃ devi śaktyā śivamayaṃ vapuḥ mūlādhāre trikoṇākte bhagakṣālitavāriṇā kāmarāgeṇa [j: vāṇena] santaptā kāmavāripipāsikā gopanīyaṃ gopanīyaṃ gopanīyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse ṣaṭtriṃśollāsaḥ tadante sādhako deva vāhyapūjāñca kākṣati ata eva mahādeva śrotumicchāmi lakṣaṇam śṛṇuṣva jagatāṃ mātaḥ śṛṇuṣva prāṇavallabhe

dvitīyasahitaṃ madyaṃ dvitīye rūpacintanam ācchādya vāsasā hastau dakṣiṇena sadā japet kāraṇaṃ hi tathā gopyaṃ gopanīyañca maithunam muktyākāṅkṣī maheśāni saṅgaṃ tyaktvā kriyāñcaret śukrapātaṃ yonirandhre [-mārge] muktistasya kare sthitā catvāri keśave kuryāda śive cārddhapradakṣiṇam tasyāśca dakṣiṇe gatvā namaskāraṃ trikoṇavat punarvṛṣam savyāsavyakrameṇaiva somasūtraṃ [j: -śukraṃ] na laṅghayet samācaret yaḥ kuryādbhaktibhāvena deve so'pi layo bhavet vanditāṃ] guruṃ namet sammukhato nānyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet hastena śirasā vāpi śirasā kevalena ca [ch, j: vā] vacasā manasā caiva praṇāmo'ṣṭāṣṭa īritaḥ pañcāṅgena nameddevaṃ devatā layabhāgbhavet tattat svarūpaṃ saṃcintya sarvāniṣṭānnamed yajet [j: jayet] namaskāraṃ tathā stotraṃ bhaktimān sādhakaścaret bhīnna] bhāṇḍodakaṃ yathā tadanyaṃ pūjanaṃ stotraṃ kathamanyasya kārayet [j: kāraṇam] ataśca sādhako devi sveṣṭānyaṃ stotramācaret nṛtyaṃ śṛṅgārabhāvena devatā prītibhāgbhavet [ch, j: -nāśakaḥ] tataśca dehī parame daśame'pi layo bhavet tṛtīye romaharṣañca caturthe'śruprapātanam

saptame patito bhūmau jñānājñāno'pi cāṣṭame daśame parameśāni gāne pāne ca jāyate devatāveśasaṃgrāhyanṛtyaṃ vādyañca gāyanam śaṅkarī] iti śrīsarvānandanātha viracite sarvollāse saptatriṃśadullāsaḥ pañcame'pye katolaṃ syāt tataḥ pūrṇaṃ pivenmadhu tadūrddhaṃ madhupāneṣu niyamaḥ kaḥ kṣamo bhavet viparīta krame māne [gh: krameṇaiva] tolakaṃ prathamāvadhi tadante maithunaṃ kuryād bhagavāri pivenmudā mudrāyuktaṃ tṛtīye'pi caturthe mīnasaṃyutam athavā lavaṇe [navame] nāpi sarvapātrāṇi kārayet maheśvari] tathā lehyaṃ peyaṃ hi svecchayā śive yena tena prakāreṇa carvaṇaṃ parikalpayet [ch, j: parikalpanam] iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvāllāse aṣṭatriṃśadullāsaḥ krīḍayā ca kimadbhutaṃ kathaya prāṇavallabha phalamānandavijñeyaṃ kāraṇobhayamīlitam taddravyaṃ naiva gṛhṇāti kuṇḍalīparadevatā athavā tatsute dattvā pānaṃ tat [k, kh, c: yat] phaladāyakam tailaṃ vinā yathā dīpe varttidānaṃ tathā dhruvam madhupānena saṃmato ghātayed yonimaṇḍale śakticakraṃ tridhā kṛtvā śakti bhāle likhet tataḥ tridhā kṛtvā likhedbhāle madhye miśraṃniyojayet śivakoṇaṃ madhyadeśe trivindu tritvabhāṣitam ūrddhe raktam adhaḥ śvetaṃ miśraṃ madhye niyojayet śaktāvāvāhanaṃ nāsti yato devī svarūpiṇī

pūjayitvā ramet śaktiṃ vīrya pāte visarjanam tu sambhoge] caiva devyagre devatā prītibhāgbhavet pūrṇānando bhavet so'pi sambhogaṃ mama sammatam yadā rameccakrabhinne gurorājñānusārataḥ sā nārī kālikārūpā śukra pātaṃ bhage [j: bhaved] yadi tadājñayāpi tadyonau guruśca ramaṇañcaret gurutvaṃ hi layaṃ yasmāt punaścakraṃ niyojaye ramaṇaṃ naiva karttavyaṃ kṛte'pi patito bhavet ata eva maheśāni veśyāśaktipraphullikā [gh, c: śaktiḥ-] sparśanāt puṇyabhāgloko [gh, c: -loke] ghātanācca kriyānvitaḥ pūtātmā puṇyabhāgīca kriyāśaktaḥ śivobhavet yogyāt śivatvaṃ sāyujyaṃ śakre nirvāṇa bhāgbhavet mathunaṃ kārayed dhīrastadbhinne [j: vīra-] narakaṃ vrajet vidhānene varārohe kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtale mathunaṃ śrotumicchāmi yathāvidhi vidhānakam maithunena vinā devi sarvakāryaṃ vṛthā bhavet anyathāpi kṛtaṃ kāryyaṃ sa cumbako na saṃśayaḥ tadarthe maithunaṃ devi proktaṃ hi vidhibodhitam taṃ dṛṣṭvā sādhako devi yonyā ghrāṇaṃ samācaret śakterājñāṃ vinā devi valena maithunaṃ caret sa śaṭhaḥ sāpi śaktiśca tatkṣaṇāttaṃ parityajet dāmbhikaṃ taṃ vijānīyāt tasyā [j: tathā] lāpaṃ parityajet nāśakam ramaṇaṃ hi prakarttavyaṃ surabhāvena [c: surā-] bhāvitaḥ prakāśañca karomyadya na prakāśyaṃ kadācana

maithunārthe'pi tvaṃ devi nārīdehe sadā sthitā ahaṃ jñānaṃ samāśritya deheṣu dihināmadhṛk sthūle sūkṣme kriyāśakta stejasi khalu pārvati [gh: śaṅkari] maithunaṃ puṇyajanitaṃ kriyākto jñānavān yadi teṣāṃ madhye cādyabījaṃ maithunāktaṃ kriyeti ca bhāvārthe'pi mahādeva sthūladehe kriyā yutā puruṣasya sukhaṃ deva nārīdeheṣu maithunam strī puṃrūpamahaṃ tvañca ramaṇārthe prakāśitaṃ iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse catvāriṃśadullāsaḥ ratestulyaṃ mahānandaṃ teṣāṃ madhye na vidyate tadānandaṃ kathaṃ bhadre cānyatattveṣu vidyate śaktirūpāhyahaṃ tena tiṣṭhāmi ca gṛhe gṛhe śivāpyaham ahaṃ tvaṃ strī pumān rūpo [gh: rūpe] tiṣṭhāmi bhāvahetave kīṭādiṣu varārohe maithunārthe sadā sthitaḥ tena tena prakāreṇa vicaratyapi bhūtale sthirānandaṃ pañcameṣu pañcamaṃ muktidāyakam ānandena vinā dehī kṣaṇamātraṃ na tiṣṭhati yataśca [gh, ch: ataśca] maithunānadaṃ prakṛti puruṣātmakam brahma jñānaṃ yadā devi tadā brāhmaṇa ucyate madyapāne bhavejjñānī maithune tattavavān bhavet bhāvabhedena kathaya sādhakānanda - lakṣaṇam kriyātmano lakṣaṇaṃ hi bahudhā prakaṭīkṛtam yena mārgeṇa deveśi phalabhāg jāyate naraḥ vinā mudrāṃ pivenmadyaṃ niṣphalaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ

carvvaṇena vinā madyaṃ niṣphalaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ bhāvātīte kriyā naṣṭā vidyā naṣṭā kuleśvari ata eva kriyāmārgī atipānaṃ nacācaret ata eva kriyāmārgī [j: maheśāni] hyatipānaṃ nacācaret ānandenaiva jñātavyaṃ sādhakasyāpi lakṣaṇam jāyate maithunaṃ raktarahitam adhamānandakaṃ śive bahupātre cādhamasya kvacidānanda mīritam iti sarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse ekacatvāriṃśadullāsaḥ adhunā śrotumicchāmi sādhakānanda lakṣaṇam lubdhakaḥ bhāvātītaṃ pivenmadyaṃ sarva prāṇi hite rataḥ prāṇi naṣṭe cātmanaṣṭaṃ tritattvaṃ jñāni sevitam ata eva paṅka tattvaṃ pratyekaṃ jñāna dāyakam deve tritattvaṃ paramaṃ [j: parame] pañcatattvāsure śive anayośca yathā bhedaṃ tat śṛṇuṣva maheśvari siddhāntaśca bhavedbhāvaḥ kaulaśca bhāva varjitaḥ kaulācārasya bījaṃ hi divyaḥ siddhānta eva ca divyo deva svarūpaśca siddhānto deva eva ca jñānahetave] ānandaṃ pratipātrasya mama sthāne kramādvada tanmayaṃ niścalaṃ śāntaṃ ullāsādimudīritam nakuryyādadhikaṃ hetuṃ mudrācarvvaṇakāni ca lakṣamalakṣamanyañca tanmayañcadvitīyakam kvaciddhyānaṃ japādiñca kvaciccarvaṇa mācaret

viśrānti vāsanā yatrāpyullāsaṃ tat tṛtīyakam sthitaḥ tanmayañca tadākāraṃ caturthānandamīritam śakti vīrārpitaṃ yadyattattad grāhyāṇi carvaṇam lakṣaṇañca varārohe pañcamaṃ parikīrtitam saptame samatā [j: layatā] cakre tantre milanatā bhavet na kiñcidṛṣṭamānandaṃ kārya kāraṇameva ca nṛtya gīta sadollāsaṃ kuryādvīrāṅganā saha kriyātītaṃ kalātītaṃ mano'tītaṃ sunirmalam viśrāmamupaviṣṭā vā nopaviṣṭaṃ yathārpitam parātmakam svecchācāraṃ kriyāmātraṃ kevalātma sukhoditam utthāya punaḥ pītvā, pītvā pītvāpi maithunam vināśa kāraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ sthiteḥ kāraṇameva ca idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi maithunasya ca lakṣaṇam tava snehena vaddho'haṃ gopanīyaṃ manaḥsthiram citrāsane nātinīce nāticocce maheśvari maithunaṃ] priyām kāraṇaṃ pūritaṃ pātraṃ mūle dattvā mukhe muhuḥ sarvaṃ dattvā mukhe devyāṃ paścādātmani yojayet taccakrasya ca māhātmyaṃ varṇitaṃ naiva śakyate mūlena sparśanaṃ kṛtvā mūlena liṅgaveśanam rasanā coṣaṇaṃ devi maithunaṃ tadanantaram ghātanānte] manuṃsmaret gurave dakṣiṇārthāya cāṣṭavāraṃ japenmanum

śivo'hamiti matvā ca ramaṇaṃ mama sammatam yoni jñānaṃ vinā deva maithunaṃ na śubha pradam madhye devīṃ yajed gānaṃ pānaṃ nṛtyaṃ japañcaret yasyāvabodhanāddehe dehī brahma mayo bhavet na vaktavyaṃ kadācittu pāṣaṇḍe nāstike nare asya prapaṭhanāddeva jīvanmukto'pi jāyate daśavidyāsvarūpātmā yonirmāṃ pātu sarvadā jagadānanda saṃbhūtā yonirmāṃ pātu sarvadā brahma viṣṇu śiva prāṇā yonirmāṃ pātu sarvadā bhukti mukti pradā yoniryonirmāṃ pātu sarvadā sarvadā sukhadā madanāgārā yonirmāṃ pātu sarvadā manoharā duḥkha labhā yonirmāṃ pātu sarvadā sarva prasavakartrī tvaṃ yonirmāṃ pātu sarvadā sarva gehe [gh, j: dehe] sthitā yoniryonirmāṃ pātu sarvadā ārogyadā vīra ratā pañca tatva yutā sadā [gh, j: yutā] śaktirūpā mahādevī tasya gehe sadā sthirā muktirakhaṇḍitā satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ mamavākyaṃ vṛthā nahi kṛtāñjali puṭobhūtvā paṭhet stotraṃ digambara ! [ch, j: cānyathā] anyathā pūjanāddeva ramaṇaṃ maraṇaṃ bhavet niśāyāṃ sammukhe śaktyāḥ sa śivo nātra saṃśayaḥ vāmahaste pradātavyaṃ guhyā di mantra pūrvakam tīrtha snāna sahasra koṭi phaladaṃ śrīcakra pādodakam

liṅga kṣālita toyena prakṣiped vindu bindubhiḥ sugandhaṃ śītalaṃ toyaṃ prakṣipet tattva mudrayā guroḥ pātrād deva pātrādātma pātrānmaheśvari tattoyaiḥ kardamaṃ kṛtvā lalāṭe tilakaṃ nyaset śakti pātrāt pātramātrāt toyaṃ kṣiptaṃ mahītale toyaṃ kṣipet svamūrddhādi binduñca tattva mudrayā sa eva dāsatāṃ yāti yadi śakra samo bhavet avaśiṣṭa jalairdevi kardame tilakaṃ nyaset cakrānte parameśāni śānti stotraṃ paṭhenmudā sānandamānandamayīṃ smarāi [k kh, g, gh, c: bhajāmi] māheśvarāṇāṃ [gh, c: ma-] divasāḥ prayāntu dine dine sādhaka saṅgamastu [j: saṅgamo'stu] bhuktiñca muktiñca parāṃ vrajāmaḥ stattaddinaṃ durdinameva manye tatkṣaṇena prayānti stathā nāśamupaiti śīghram vaṃbhramyate kaulika [j: sādhaka] cakravartti yadbhairavo'haṃ jananīṃ smarāmi [k, kh, g, c: samohe] bhramantyanāsvādita [ch, j: anāsādita] kaula mārgāḥ maireya [kh, c: naivedya] pānaṃ vayamācarāmaḥ śrīsundarī cintanameva yasya daṅgīkṛtaḥ samprati kaulamārgaḥ śrīsundarīṃ cetasi vismarāmi lokān

bhogaśca mokṣaśca karastha eva kaula dharmmaḥ parama gahano yogināmapyagamyaḥ [ch: bhaktiñca] bhuktiṃ vrajet gaṅgāṃ pivāmi yamunāṃ saha sāgareṇa mūrdhni śrīnātha pādābjaṃ smaraṇaṃ kimataḥ param kula strī saṅga nirataḥ kulakāryaṃ samācaret pānañca viṣa pānaṃ syāt maithunaṃ pāpadāyakam catvāri [k, kh g: catvāraḥ] tasya naśyanti āyurvidyā yaśo valam abhiṣekaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvasiddhi pradāyakam sarvāśā pūrakaṃ sarva mantra doṣa vināśanam abhicāra haraṃ sarvaṃ grahadoṣa vināśanam takṣakeṇāpi daṣṭasya viṣapīḍā vināśanam strīkṛteṣvapi doṣeṣu śarīre mānase tathā asaubhāgye ca nārīṇāmabhiṣekaḥ pravarttate nadī tīre deva bhūmau taru mūle catuṣpathe mantreṇānena deveśi tīrthānyāvāhayettataḥ sarve samudrāḥ saritaḥ sarāṃsi jaladā hradāḥ [ gh, j: nadāḥ] sarvetīrthāni puṇyāni ghaṭe kurvantu sannidhim sthirākṛtiḥ mūlena dūrvāṃ praṇavaiḥ kuryādabhyukṣaṇaṃ tataḥ tatrāvāhya prapūjayet mantreṇānena deśikaḥ vāmutranirghoṣaḥ] yaśo dhanāyustejaḥsu śrīphalasyāpi pallavaiḥ dṛśyate

asaubhāgye ca nārīṇāṃ dūrvābhirabhiṣecanam athavā sarva kāryeṣu vidadhyādāmra pallavaiḥ śmaśāna bhairavī devī tripurānanda bhairavī tripureśī mahādevī tathā tripuramālikā etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇā bhuvaneśvarī etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇā bhagamālinī sarvacakreśvarī devī tathā nīlasarasvatī etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇā etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantra pūtena vāriṇā etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantra pūtena vāriṇā puṣṭirmedhā śivā sādhvī yaśaḥ śobhā jayā dhṛtiḥ etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantra pūtena vāriṇā ratistathā cakrī jayāvatī brāhmī jayantī cāparājitā māyācaiva mahāmāyā mohinī kṣobhiṇī tathā durgā kriyārūndhatī ca ghaṇṭākarṇā kapālinī surūpā vṛdvarūpā ca tathaiva vigrahātmikā vaivasvatī ca kaumārī tathā māheśvarī parā etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantra pūtena vāriṇā pratyaṅgirā bhavānī ca vālā dhūmāvatī tathā caitanyabhairavī rudrabhairavī purabhairavī etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇā etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantra pūtena vāriṇā

tithayaścābhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇā rāhuḥ ketuśca satatamabhiṣiñcantu te grahāḥ dagdhaṃ pāpaṃ tathā bhadrā yogo vārāḥ kṣaṇāstathā abhiṣiñcantu satataṃ mantra pūtena vāriṇā lākinī putrakāścānye kākinī putrakā'pare tataśca ḍākinī putrā devī putrāstataḥ param abhiṣiñcantu te sarve mantra putena vāriṇā ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantra pūtena vāriṇā abhiṣiñcintu satataṃ mantra pūtena vāriṇā ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantra pūtena vāriṇā śrīpuruṣottamam (krī/) etāni tvabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇā ātreyī bhāratī caiva sarayūrgaṇḍakī tathā etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantra pūtena vāriṇā ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantra pūtena vāriṇā vāriṇā ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantra pūtena vāriṇā vauṣaṭkārastu phaṭkāro'bhiṣiñcantu sarvadā piśācā guhyakā bhūtā abhiṣekeṇa tāḍitāḥ naśyantu cābhiṣekeṇa tārāvījena (strī/) tāḍitāḥ naśyantu cābhiṣekeṇa vāgbījenaiva (ai/) tāḍitāḥ naśyantu cābhiṣekeṇa manmathenaiva (klī/) tāḍitāḥ naśyantu cābhiṣekeṇa śaktibījena (hrī/) tāḍitāḥ naśyantu cābhiṣekeṇa kālībījena (krī/) tāḍitāḥ abhiṣekeṇa śāktena pūrṇāḥ santu manorathāḥ

sa eva dakṣiṇācāraḥ sarvatantreṣu gopitaḥ pañca tattva yuto vīraḥ śivaḥ sākṣānna saṃśayaḥ kalāṃ kālīṃ cintayitvā pūjayedramaṇena tu mohāt yaḥ kurute bhedaṃ rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet kulajñā yatra tiṣṭhanti tatra tiṣṭhāmi bhāvinī śivo'hamiti saṃjñāya viharet śakti saṅkaṭe vāmā cāraḥ sa vijñeyo vāmā bhūtvā yajet parām [j: śivām] golakaṃ pañcadhā puṣpaiḥ pūjayet parameśvarīm saptapuṣpeṇa saṃpūjya niśīthe ramaṇena tu anuddhṛtena puṣpeṇa ramaṇenārccayet śivām yathā svayambhūkusumādiñca devānāmapi durlabham tacchoṇitaṃ maheśāna svapuṣpaṃ parikīrtitam tad dravyañca mahādeva svayambhu kusumaṃ prabho pūrṇakālodbhavaṃ] priya tadraktaṃ golakaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvakālodbhavaṃ śṛṇu tadraktaṃ parameśāna sarva kālodbhavaṃ priya tat puṣpaṃ vīra puṣpañca svayambhū kusumaṃ śṛṇu cāṇḍālyāḥ kuhusambhavaṃ] pūtātmanaśca pūtātmā sarvaṃ pūtaṃ maheśvari sarvaṃ pūtañcāśucitaṃ svakārye nādhikāritā anāsthaiva maheśāni sarva karma vinaśyati sarva pūtaṃ hi vijñeyaṃ sarva kārye'dhikāritā caturddaśa svaropetaṃ nādavindu vibhūṣitam śodhayeddaśadhā japtvā svayambhū kusumaṃ priya

tadante vahnibījantu śuddhaṃ kuṇḍodbhavaṃ priya māyābījatrayañcoktvā śodhayet golakaṃ priya sarvakālodbhavaṃ dravyaṃ śodhayet bahuyatnataḥ gopīcandanamīśāna śodhayet bahuyatnataḥ pūjayettu kuleśānīṃ kulācāreṇa sādhakaḥ śodhayet pūjayeddevīṃ yatra tatraiva kalpanam [kh: siddhaye] mūtrodakena śukreṇa yajedāvaraṇaṃ yataḥ namo'ntoyaṃ mahādeva mūtra śuddhirvidhīyate śabda bījantu tasyānte phaḍanta mantramīritam sāmānya śuddhaṃ taddravyaṃ viśeṣaṃ mantra bhāṣitam yonimudreti paramā pañca mudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ pañcatattvamidaṃ proktaṃ pañcatattvodbhavaṃ dhruvam pañcatattvamayaṃ śubham] tejo'ṃśena bhavenmudrā vāyvaṃśenāpi kāraṇam kṣityaṃśaṃ śuṣkarūpaṃ hi toyāṃśenāpi cārdrayet vāyvaṃśenāpi tanmudrāṃ nānārūpadharāṃ parām athavā pañcatatvena pañcamena yajet śivām śaktyājñayāpi śāktaḥ syāt śakti jñānena kutracit pañcatattvena saṃpūjya svadehaṃ śaktisaṃyutam śrotumicchāmi prāṇeśa lakṣaṇaṃ kulayoṣitām madyapāne'pyaśaktā yā kulabhraṣṭā sanātani viparītaṃ [gh, j: -ta] kuladravye vijñeyā kulayoṣitām sā nārī parameśāni vijñeyā kulayoṣitā sā nārī parameśāni vijñeyā kula yoṣitā sā nārī parameśāni vijñeyā kulayoṣitā

vibhinne [c: vistīrṇe] kula dātavyaṃ svakulānanda hetave nārīmātreṣu vijñeyā deveṣu kulayoṣitā ata eva mahāvīrastadanyāṃ naiva laṅghayet kulaṃ kiñca mahādevi mama sthāne prakāśaya parapuṣpākṛti sthānaṃ kulāgāraṃ [j: -re] prakāśitam paścimānanam tathā [j: yathā jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ tathā] kulasthānamidaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvabījasya bījakam tadbījaṃ kiṃ maheśāni tadbhinnaṃ nārī vā katham kulasthānaṃ vinā śaktijñānamātraṃ na jāyate nitamba jaghana sphītā parapuṣpa bhaga prabhā gopitā; g: madhye sugopitam] madhyame pūjite bhaktirhīne'pi kārya sādhanam parājitā puṣpa rūpā kulāgārañca madhyagam [j: madhyamam] aṇḍa jātaṃ svedajātaṃ bīja jātaṃ tridhā śive liṅgamadhye sthitaṃ śukraṃ yonimadhye ca śoṇitam tasya bījaṃ na vidyeta gadituṃ naiva śakyate tejādhikye bīja jātaṃ kṣityādhikye'pi mānuṣam kriyāyogo dhyāna yogo bhakti yogo bhaviṣyati trikoṇākāra rūpā sā sarvadevālayā priye [gh: śive] tripureśī yonimadhye mūle vasati bhairavī roma kūpe mahākālī mātaṅgī mekhalāsu ca bindupuṣpatarormūle kuṇḍalī brahmavigrahā pīṭhaṃ kāma svarūpañca dvividhaṃ parameśvari praṇavākāra rūpeṇa yonyākāraṃ vicintayet

vyaktāyāścaiva guptāyā lakṣaṇaṃ kiṃ prakāśaya guptārccane'pi muktiḥ syād bhakti bhāva yuto yadi darśanāt lakṣa pīṭhānāṃ phalaṃ yadvaravarṇini sparśanāt sarva pīṭhānāṃ phalamāpnoti sādhakaḥ tiṣṭhanti tāni tīrthāni yoni pīṭheṣu sundari sarasvatī madhyabhāge vāmeṣu jāhnavī parā kṣetre tīrthāni tiṣṭhanti sarvāṇi [j: cānyāni] parameśvari adhunā śrotumicchāmi lakṣaṇaṃ kula yoṣitām tallakṣaṇānvito jñeyaḥ sādhakaḥ kula yoṣitaḥ jñānināṃ jñānarūpedaṃ kulasya lakṣaṇaṃ śive iti śrīsarvānandanātha viracite sarvollāse pañcāśadullāsaḥ tava prītikarī devi cocyatāṃ bhava bandhanāt yoni tattvaṃ vinā naiva kula dharma [k: dhana] parāyaṇaḥ vismṛtaṃ punarucyeta śapathaṃ me punaḥ punaḥ na vaktavyaṃ punarhyetat śapathaṃ me punaḥ punaḥ rajojjvalā; j: rajasvalā] śukrikā śukra [j: reta] jananī tasyāṃ pūjā mahāphalā dhyātvā kuryāt sadā saṅgaṃ śukre bīja prapātanam kevalaṃ vāpi puṣpeṇa śodhitaṃ tannivedayet tadā śukreṇa dātavyaṃ cānukalpaṃ kuleśvari pratyakṣasyāpi yogyatvaṃ cānukalpeṣu saṃsthitam svasvavarṇayutaṃ dravyaṃ tad dravyasyānukalpanam dhyātvā yajenmaheśāni madhye [j: savye] śukra prapātanam tathā priye parasparaṃ bhavedbījaṃ vāyurākāśayoryathā

bījarūpaṃ mahādevaṃ sṛṣṭiśakti [k, g: sṛṣṭiṃ-] svarūpakam prādurbhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ paraspara vivakṣitam śaktistatra mahādevi sūkṣmarūpeṇa bhāṣitā pañcadhāpyekadhā [k, g: ekadā] yatra nānārūpavatī śivā avinābhāva sambandhaṃ dvayoreva parasparam śaktyāktaśaṅkaram [j: śaktyātu śaṅkaraḥ] śaktiśca puruṣeṣvāktā [j: puruṣeṇa] yadā sarva prakāśinī śiva jñānaṃ vinā kiñcit [k: kaścit] śaktijñānaṃ na jāyate iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse ekapañcāśadullāsaḥ ataśca bahujanmānte śakti jñānaṃ prajāyate sā śaktirvāmā vijñeyā puruṣasyāpi muktidā dāyinī vyaktā ramaṇa tuṣṭā cet guptā ramaṇa tuṣṭitā atastebhyaḥ pradhānaṃ hi śaktiṃ viddhi mahāmate saiva sarveśvarī devi [k: devī] sa ca sarvo maheśvaraḥ kāryākāryaṃ maheśāni tasyā eva na saṃśayaḥ kāryākāryaṃ bhavet śakternirliptaḥ [j: yasyā-] puruṣaḥ śive kriyā śakterbhavet kāryaṃ prāṇināṃ sarvasādhane athavāpi śivaṃ jñeyaṃ dehinaṃ śakti bījakam vāmājñānaṃ maheśāni sthūla sūkṣma pramāṇakam abhāve svastriyaṃ devi kathamuktaṃ sadāśive brahma dattāgninā hutvā śiva dattā tu kāmataḥ sandeho naiva kartavyo mama vākyānusārataḥ svavāmā toṣaṇārthe'pi para vāmāñca toṣayet toṣayet parameśāni [gh: -na] vīrabhāva samāśritaḥ

ramaṇaṃ śaktisaṃyuktaṃ svadeheṣu viśeṣakam svaśakti ramaṇārthe'pi paraśaktiṃ ramet śive svaśaktiṃ paraśaktiṃ vā caikāṃ jñātvā ramet śivām tādṛk sukhaṃ śarīrasya kadācinnaiva jāyate ramā pūjanamātreṇa ramā tasya kare sthitā ata eva kulācārī mukhena bhaktibhāg bhavet svecchācāre yoni garte liṅgaṃ dadyāt tadājñayā maithunaṃ cet śakti yuktaṃ kevalaṃ śakterājñayā svagehe pāyasaṃ tyaktvā bhikṣāmaṭati durmatiḥ iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse dvāpañcāśadullāsaḥ sadānandaḥ sadā śāntaḥ siddhāntācāra ucyate na te paśyanti taṃ devaṃ vṛthā teṣāṃ pariśramaḥ kulaṃ śīlaṃ tathā jātiścāṣṭau pāśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ sa jīvaḥ parameśāni śiva eva na saṃśayaḥ ata eva kulācārī ātmānaṃ toṣayenmudā bhogaśca mokṣaśca karastha eva ātmānaṃ devatāṃ matvā toṣayedramaṇādinā karasthaṃ kaustubhaṃ tyaktvā bhramate kāca tṛṣṇayā jīvaṃ deva [gh, j: brahma] mayaṃ jñātvā toṣayed bhojanādiṣu sukhaduḥkhādayaḥ sarve jīvasyāpi maheśvari vimohanāya lokānāṃ tasmāt sama manā bhavet bheda bhāva [k: -bhāvo] mano yasya tasya mokṣo na jāyate sarvaṃ dehamayaṃ [j: deva] jñātvā dehaṃ [j: ayaṃ] śive jīva jñānaṃ vinā devi śiva jñānaṃ na cet kvacit ātmabrahmeti saṃjñātvā devabrahmeti bhāvayet

śarīraṃ vyāpitaṃ yadyat jīvaṃ [j: śivaṃ] jñeyaṃ kuleśvari tato devamayaṃ jīvaṃ dehaṃ jīvamayaṃ smaret iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse tripañcāśadullāsaḥ idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi maithunānanda lakṣaṇam niyojya nandinaṃ dvāre nirgaccha [k: nirgatya] rati mandiram yat kṛtvā sādhaka śreṣṭhaḥ śivo'bhūt parameśvara madyapānaṃ vinā deva maithunaṃ pāpadāyakam pānaṃ maithuna saṃyuktaṃ jīvasya mukti dāyakam indriyākalitaṃ sarvaṃ rūpa mānādivarjitam ānandaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ khaṇḍaṃ pūrṇaṃ kuleśvara atipānaṃ na karttavyamatipātraṃ na dāpayet dīyamāne kriyā lupte kruddhā bhavati kāminī yadānandayutā nārī tadā maccharīraṃ śiva karomyahaṃ gānapānaṃ svayaṃ devīsvarūpiṇī prakāśe'pi svayaṃ devī sākṣādbhavati sādhakaḥ śaṅkarīm svakāntāṃ parakāntāṃ vā sālokyaṃ darśane śive nirvāṇañca yadānandaṃ [j: dayā-] mama sthāne prakāśaya tat sukhaṃ sarvadā deva sālokye [j: sālokyaṃ] nātra saṃśayaḥ tatsukhaṃ sarvadā deva sārūpye nātra saṃśayaḥ tatsukhaṃ sarvadā deva sāyujye [j: sāyujya] nātra saṃśayaḥ jāyate sarvadā deva nirvāṇe nātra saṃśayaḥ pūrṇānandasya māhātmyaṃ mama sthāne prakāśaya bhāvātītaṃ yadā jñānaṃ pūrṇānandaṃ tadā bhavet jāyate

ānandasya kramaṃ kutra niścitaṃ kena vartmanā bhāvātītamayaṃ vākyaṃ bhāvātītamayaṃ stavam bhāvātītamayā] kriyā kvacid dhyānaṃ japādiñca kvacinmaithunamācaret sammatam [j: saṃyutām] mukhe yad yat pradātavyaṃ bhojanānanda sammatam indriyākalitaṃ sarvaṃ prakāśaka vivarjitam sarvatra yoniṃ jñātvā'pi ghātaṃ kṛtvā muhurmuhuḥ kvacidāsye kvacit karṇe mūrdhni deśe kvacit kvacit kvacilliṅgena hastena kvacidaṃgulinā śiva dantaghātaṃ sarvagātraṃ coṣyamāṇaṃ muhurmuhuḥ kuleśi śrotumicchāmi śaktyānandasya lakṣaṇam prakāśite premānande [j: maheśāna] sarvānandasya tulyatā ānandasyāpi tulyatvaṃ pānaṃ ramaṇa tādṛśam tatkṣaṇādramaṇaṃ kuryāt ghṛṇā lajjā vivarjitā sādhyāpi patitā bhūmau sādhako ramaṇañcaret ānandena yuto deva kukkuro'pi śivo bhavet iti śrīsarvānandanātha viracite sarvollāse ṣaṭpañcāśadullāsaḥ vaśīkarttuṃ na śaknoti vāhya śaktestu kā kathā toṣayed bahu yatnena rāga dveṣa vimuktakaḥ [kh, c: vimohakaḥ] tāsāṃ prahāraṃ nindāñca kauṭilyaṃ naiva kārayet strīmātre hara patnī ca pumānmātre ca śaṅkaraḥ icchā śakterbhavedicchā kriyā śakteḥ kriyā bhavet bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ varārohe icchā śakterna saṃśayaḥ svapna labdha dhanenaiva dhanavān sa bhavedyadi

dṛḍhaḥ] vrataḥ anye ca bahavo devāḥ śakti mūlāḥ prakīrtitāḥ atastebhyaḥ pradhānaṃ hi śaktiṃ viddhi mahāmate muktiñca kāṃkṣati na te paśyanti taṃ devaṃ vṛthā teṣāṃ pariśramaḥ ātmānaṃ cintayeddevīṃ paramātma svarūpiṇīm aikyaṃ saṃbhāvayennityaṃ svagurūṃ devatātmakam naraḥ ahaṃ devo na cānyo'smi mukto'hamiti bhāvayet durgāyāścintanād durgā bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ jarā maraṇa kuḥkhādyairmucyate bhava bandhanāt adhunā haṃsa bījasya māhātmyaṃ kathaya priya tava snehena baddho'haṃ kiñcidbhāvaṃ prakāśitam haṃsa bījaṃ samāśritya dehī dehe sadā sthitaḥ śiva śaktyātmakaṃ mantramajapeti prakīrtitam ajapā nāma gāyatrīṃ jīvo japati sarvadā prajapet kena mūlañca so'haṃ kena vicintayet jīvātmānaṃ nādarūpaṃ binduñca paramātmakam vindu dvayaṃ visargaḥ syāt sṛṣṭiḥ sthitirmaheśvari trivinduṃ sthiti rūpañca bindumekaṃ laye punaḥ paramātmā bindurūpaṃ haṃsa bījena bhāṣitam nāhaṃ jñāne layaṃ devi bhāvā bhāva prabodhakam so'haṃ bhāvena parame'pyekadehaṃ vicintayet pūjanaṃ sarvadā kuryāt vāma dakṣa vibhedataḥ puṃdehaṃ śiva rūpakam

prakāśitam so'haṃ jñānād bhavellabhyaṃ jyotirdhyānaṃ sunirmalam sthūlaṃ tejastathā sūkṣmaṃ dhyānaṃ trividha lakṣaṇam sūkṣmaṃ nitya nirākāraṃ gaganādapi nirmalam iti sarvānandanāthaviracite sarvolllāse aṣṭa pañcāśadullāsaḥ dhyānatrayasya madhyeṣu soḥaṃ kena prajāyate tejaḥ sūkṣmabhedaṃ hi sevya sevaka varjitam saiva sarveśvarī devī sa ca sarvo maheśvaraḥ svagehe pāyasaṃ tyaktvā bhikṣāmaṭati durmatiḥ śiva śaktyātmakaṃ sūkṣmaṃ oṃ tatsad vyāpitaṃ jagat bindumekaṃ nāda yugmaṃ oṃkāraṃ brahma bodhakam aṅkamātraṃ mahādevi śiva śakti prabodhakam vāme ca paramā śaktirdakṣiṇe paramaḥ śivaḥ takāraṃ śaṅkaraṃ jñeyaṃ takāraṃ puṃstva vigraham binduyugmaṃ nādamekaṃ takāraṃ brahma bodhakam vinā svareṇa deveśi vyañjanaṃ naiva tiṣṭhati sakāraḥ śaṅkarī jñeyā takāro nāda rūpakaḥ śaṅkarī] sakārañca takārañca puruṣaṃ parameśvari pañcanādaṃ saptabindumekāṅgaṃ parameśvari satvaṃ rajastamaścaiva tri vakāreṇa bhāṣitam triyānvitaṃ; kh, c: kriyānvitam] sarva varṇa kramamidamaṅgaṃ jñeyaṃ śivopari kāraṇam tatsat jñeyaṃ brahma bījaṃ oṃkāre'bhūt prakāśitam

sṛṣṭi bījaṃ hi oṃkāraṃ laya bījaṃ trilocane dakṣiṇānāñca vāmānāṃ siddhāntānāṃ maheśvari kaulānāñcaiva divyānāṃ bhāvātītaṃ hi kevalam iti śrīsarvānandanātha viracite sarvollāse ūnaṣaṣṭyullāsaḥ prakāśite'pi kaulānāṃ divyānāṃ bhedakaṃ vada ubhayoreka bhāvena bhāvātītamayo bhavet divya vīre ca yo bhedaḥ sa bhedaḥ parikathyate mātrabhedakam] tejaḥ syāt paramāṇuśca sarva vyāpinirañjanam prasaṅgāt kathayāmyadya divyasyāpi ca lakṣaṇam tejomayaṃ jagat sarvaṃ vibhāvya mūrtti kalpanam [j: kalpitam] ṣaṣṭyullāsaḥ idaṃ vīra kulaṃ devi jñeyaṃ ramyaṃ manoharam prakāśa vākyaṃ nirdvandvamekaṃ hrasvaṃ hi dīrghakam guruṃ laghuṃ dīrghaṃ vācātītaṃ vacaḥ śive jñānaṃ jñeyamayaṃ śive jñānajñeyaṃ mano devi bhāvātītaṃ sunirmalam bhāvātitād bhavedbhāvo bīja vṛkṣeva pārvati ata eva maheśāni mano'tītaṃ nirañjanam sadā kāmena sā bhāti kalārūpā sanātanī cākhyānakīrttanaṃ] kalā ca dvividhā proktā guptā vyaktā maheśvari śmaśāna vāsino vīrāḥ kalāṃ pūjanti sarvadā iti c: pustakīyapāṭhaḥ |] yajedvīraḥ śmaśāne gopane śive vyaktāpi (?) pūjayedvīro vāhye'pi nirjane priye

udāsināṃ śmaśānañca gṛhiṇāmarccayedbhagam śavārūḍhāt tathā devi bhagārūḍhādhikārakaḥ citā vyaktāpi deveśi guptayonīti kīrtitā kalāvāsava yogena kalā pūjāṃ prakalpayet maithunena vinā devi madyapānaṃ na cācaret gatāsūnaśavaḥ prokto madya pānāsavaḥ priye śavāsane bhedakāryamabhedamāsavāsane śaktidarśanamātreṇāpyudāsināṃ kriyā kṣayaḥ puruṣasyāsanaṃ śaktiḥ śakteḥ puruṣa dehakam iti śrīsarvānandanātha viracite sarvollāse ekaṣaṣṭyullāsaḥ vṛthā pūjā bhavettasya na bījaṃ jala secanam śaktisaṅgamam] vṛthā jñānaṃ bhavettasya śaktiṣu śaktisaṅgamam te brahmajñāninaḥ santaḥ prakṛtiṃ puruṣātmakam ubhayorjñānayogena brahmajānīti niścitam ubhayorekabhāvena brahmajñānīti niścitam saiva yoni svarūpā ca [gh: sā] jagadutpatti kāriṇī brahma viṣṇu śivādīnāṃ mūlāḥ sattvādayo guṇāḥ sthūla sūkṣmamayaṃ jyotirvyāpitā prakṛtiḥ sthitā vācakam] punaḥ pralīyate yasyā [gh, j: tasyāṃ] tasyāśca jāyate punaḥ vikṛtiḥ prakṛtimāpanne tataḥ kiñcinna paśyati nādhikāritāḥ; j: nādhikāriṇaḥ] triguṇe'pyekabhāvo'pi guṇaśca kena jāyate ekabhāvena prakṛtiścaṇakākāra rūpakaḥ

vibhinne śiva śaktiḥ syādabhinne caṇakaḥ śive kṣitiḥkaṃ] pāvako dhruvam triguṇa [j: trikoṇa] vyāpitaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvare jaṅgamam nirguṇasyālayaḥ sākṣānmahākālyālayaḥ priye sūkṣmadeha [j: dehe] samudbhūtā puṃdeheṣu prakāśitā ubhāvubhau ca saṃtyaktvā kṣaṇamātra na tiṣṭhati sākāraṃ yadbhaveddevi kevalaṃ bodha hetave dṛśyate parameśāni tathā sarvamidaṃ jagat sākāraṃ yadi jāyeta svecchayāpi tadā priye sākāraṃ svecchayā tasyā nirākārañca svecchayā yadā ced bahudhā bhūtā [j: bhūtvā] tadā jyotīti kīrtitā bahunā [gh, j: bahudhā] ramaṇenāpi cābhāve bhābabodhakam rūpatrayaṃ bhāvabodhaṃ sṛṣṭi sthiti layaḥ priye puruṣaṃ śive bhagañca prakṛtiṃ jñeyaṃ pumān brahmeti pārvati sarvadā vāyunā devi tatra śṛṅgārakāvubhau pāñcabhautikaḥ [gh, c: -bhautikam] kaula jñānamidaṃ devi kalpātītaṃ nirañjanam iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse dvāṣaṣṭhyullāsaḥ kaivalyaṃ kīdṛśaṃ jñānaṃ kathaya prāṇa vallabha raverutpadyate toyaṃ toyādutpadyate mahī aṇḍajaḥ svedajaścaiva udbhijjaśca jarāyujaḥ vṛkṣa gulmādayo devi udbhijjāhi hi vicetanāḥ teṣāṃ madhye manuṣyeṣu brahmajñānañca jāyate tannāśe parameśāni sūkṣmadehī prakāśitaḥ

kṣitirjalaṃ tathā tejo vāyurākāśa eva ca śravaṇaṃ darśanaṃ ghrāṇaṃ sparśanaṃ rasa bodhanam caturviṃśati tattvāni śaktiratra pṛthak pṛthak adhunā śrotumicchāmi tattat śaktyanukīrttanam gadituṃ naiva śaknomi brahmāṇḍānte'pi pārvati tāsāṃ madhye śreṣṭha [j: sṛṣṭi] rūpā caturddaśa parātmikā śaktiruktā maheśvari tridhaikoktā [gh: tridhaikātmā] kriyātmikā vināhaṅkāramātreṇa kiñcinmātraṃ na jāyate ahaṅkārasya nirlepādahaṃ brahmeti bhāṣyate yathā tathā deho maheśāni dehimadhye prakāśitaḥ taraṅga budbudau nāśe toyamātraṃ na saṃśayaḥ dehanāśe tathā deho kevalo'haṃ nirañjanaḥ [j: niraṃjanam] prabodhe tu pare tattve kevalo'haṃ nirañjanaḥ [g, j: -nam] saṃsthitam pralīnaṃ hi punastasmin kṣitau vṛkṣeva [j: brahmaiva] pārvati sṛjyate ca punastasmāt [gh: tasmin] svecchayā nija māyayā sarvaṃ hi khalvidaṃ brahma tadanyannāsti kiñcana sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ vyāptaṃ praṇamāmi jaganmayam kriyātītaṃ kriyāyuktaṃ sarvaṃ vyāpyaika saṃsthitam nirvikāraṃ vikārāktaṃ sarvaṃ vyāpyaika saṃsthitam yajajñānānnāparaṃ jñānaṃ tadbrahme tyavadhārayet ravirvilīyate vāyau vāyurvilīyate ca khe śivo vilīyate śaktau tato brahma nirūpaṇam

tadā muktimavāpno yadā [gh, j: yathā] brahmapravindati prakāraṇam; gh: prakāśakam] hāsyakautūhalādikam] līlayā brahmaṇaḥ sarvaṃ hāsya kautūhalādikam divye śarīre so'pyasti tathā kīṭādikeṣu ca svayaṃ vibhuḥ bhūta prakṛtimāśritya dehināṃ dehanāśakṛt nirmamo [j: nirmalo] nirahaṅkāraḥ sadā jyotirmayaḥ smṛtaḥ madanaṃ rūpamāśritya puruṣo vihvalāyate ātmecchayā kṛtaṃ karma doṣādoṣaṃ na cācaret ūrddhaśūnye gatistasya madhyaśūnye vyavasthitaḥ ūrddha śūnye svapna bhāvaṃ brahma randhraṃ prakīrtitam mūlādhāre adhaḥ śūnyaṃ tatra kāmādi cintanam sa tiṣṭhati paraṃ brahma svecchayā līlayāpi ca dhyāna pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ tasya siddhirna jāyate ata eva maheśāna kalau siddhirna jāyate yo vijānāti tattvena dehānte brahmabhāg bhavet iti śrīsarvānandanātha viracite sarvollāse triṣaṣṭyullāsaḥ
